Dear Friend,

I'm sorry to bother you with this email, but sometimes I feel like I have to vent a little bit. After all the years my husband, Chuck, has been in the Senate, he never lets anything get under his skin.

As a lifelong farmer, he's weathered the storms of Mother Nature and cyclical markets. Thank goodness he's got nerves of steel. The Biden administration's reckless spending has fueled the fires of inflation, and its radical open border agenda makes every state a border state.

I just wish there was something I could do to make his day...

That's why I asked one of my husband's fundraising managers, Kurt, if there was anything I could do to help. He asked me to write this email, and here we are.

Apparently, an important fundraising deadline is approaching, and it's not looking the best.

I just _KNOW_ that Chuck would love to help his conservative allies in the Senate and see Republicans win across the board. If we meet this deadline, we can gain the momentum we need to regain the Senate Republican Majority.

**I know times are tough, and the Biden economy is pinching your wallet at the grocery store from one week to the next. It would make a huge difference if you can spare $5, $10, or even just $1.**

So, Friend, I'd love to see Chuck smile at the end of this deadline when I surprise him with the fundraising report. I'm hoping I can count on you to help out.

**Chuck 's team set up some buttons below to help you make a contribution. The process to end partisan gerrymandering is a marathon.
|

Friends,
We all know this to be true: **Reaching fair maps and ending gerrymandering once and for all is a marathon.**
Sometimes it can be difficult to wrap our heads around just how big of a task we have before us. But here at All On The Line, we always remind ourselves that there are milestone victories along the way.
Just look at the new legislative maps in Wisconsin or more representative congressional districts in Louisiana — those victories and so many others are so important for the long game.

body:
And it's time the ultra-rich paid their fair share.
#
Taxes are due today for most households across the country.
The bad news first: in 2023, billionaires in the United States added roughly $1.2 trillion to their personal wealth. Many will only pay between 4 - 8.5% in taxes on those “unrealized capital gains,” while the average working family will pay 13.6%.1
**But here’s some good news** : Roughly 69% of Americans across the political spectrum — polled in 7 different swing states2 – support higher taxes on billionaires and people who make more than $400,000 a year.
Since Alexandria’s first day on the campaign trail, our movement has demanded that the rich pay their fair share. **Looks like more and more working families agree.**
[Alexandria is going to keep fighting for economic justice for all of us, even while members of both parties are invested in protecting tax breaks for yacht owners and people with private jets. Will you chip in $5 today to power her fight?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240415.CN_7uL&refcode=em20240415-6201-P_FND_EGR_TAX&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6201%2E2526796%2E6ICKLL)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240415.CN_7uL&refcode=em20240415-6201-P_FND_EGR_TAX&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6201%2E2526796%2E6ICKLL)**
Here’s some more good news: so far, tax returns in 2024 are averaging $3,011 — up $123 from 2023.3
Recent estimates show that the top 1% were the most significant tax evaders in the country in 2021. Yet the House GOP made it their top priority to claw back 25% of funding allocated to the IRS by Democrats in the Inflation Reduction Act.
**Why should single moms and veterans have to pay for giveaways to the rich?** It’s time for the top 1% and corporations to pay their fair share.
[Alexandria doesn’t curry favor from billionaires or host fancy cocktail fundraisers asking wealthy people for big checks. She’s relying on support from people like you. Can you contribute $5 today to keep Alexandria in Congress fighting for economic justice for all of us?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240415.CN_7uL&refcode=em20240415-6201-P_FND_EGR_TAX&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=6201%2E2526796%2E6ICKLL)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240415.CN_7uL&refcode=em20240415-6201-P_FND_EGR_TAX&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=6201%2E2526796%2E6ICKLL)**
Whether or not you can contribute today, thank you for standing with our movement.
Thank you,
Team AOC

2 - [**Bloomberg** : Tax the Rich Is Actually a Popular Bipartisan Stance, Poll Shows](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/23508?t=24&akid=6201%2E2526796%2E6ICKLL)
3 - [**CNN** : Today is Tax Day. The IRS expects ‘tens of millions’ of returns to be filed at the last minute](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/23509?t=25&akid=6201%2E2526796%2E6ICKLL)

But we will also need the resources to continue responding to GOP attacks — especially those from Donald Trump and his MAGA extremists.

Because of the way that we are running this campaign — and the fact we are not accepting corporate PAC contributions — it’s not the size of the contribution that matters, it’s the number of contributions we receive — $3, $10, or $25 at a time.

body:
Min Beats Baugh By Over $300k | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/153cc6eb5b1f/dave-min-outraises-republican-scott-baugh-in-ca-15673375?e=7017cc100e)
---
| |
---
| | **For Immediate Release:** April 15, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Dave Min Outraises
Republican Scott Baugh in CA-47**
**IRVINE, CA** — On the heels of a commanding primary election win in California’s 47th Congressional District, Dave Min has outraised his Republican opponent Scott Baugh. **Min brought in $683,475 receipts in the first quarter of 2024.** National Democrats have made CA-47 a priority following Rep. Katie Porter’s narrow 3 point victory over perennial candidate Scott Baugh in 2022.

**“I couldn’t be prouder of the support we’ve received throughout Orange County and across the country,”** said Senator Dave Min. **“The response to our message has been overwhelming. Voters are tired of Republicans’ failed leadership, regressive priorities and lies about the 2020 election. They’re ready to fight to preserve the American Dream for our children and our grandchildren, focused on the values of safety, inclusion, bodily autonomy and economic opportunity.”**

Senator Min, representing over 80% of CA-47 in the State Senate, brings a solid track record of victories in Orange County. His 2020 win over a long-standing Republican incumbent marked him as the first Democrat to represent the region in the State Senate. Senator Min has been a champion of women’s reproductive rights, gun safety, and climate justice in the California Legislature, and he has also been a stalwart leader on public safety and education issues, earning the endorsements of Orange County’s Police Officers, Deputy Sheriffs, Firefighters, and Teachers.

Senator Min is set to face off against Republican Scott Baugh, a career politician who has been a lobbyist and perennial Congressional candidate for the past 25 years, losing in 2018 and 2022. While Scott Baugh began his career as a corrupt State Assemblymember, engaging in campaign finance fraud, perjury, and obstruction of justice, which led to his being indicted for 22 criminal charges (including 4 felony counts), Dave Min began his career cracking down on corporate fraud and corruption as an SEC prosecutor. While Baugh has embraced whackjob conspiracy theories associated with white nationalism, stating that “wokeness” was a more dangerous threat to America’s security than 9/11 or World War II, Min has repeatedly celebrated diversity and stood up against hate in Orange County. And while Baugh has made clear that he would support a total abortion ban, without exceptions, even in the case of rape, incest, or danger to a woman’s life, Min has earned a 100% rating from Planned Parenthood and authored eight leading domestic violence bills into law. ###

California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country.

Hello,
I really hate sending emails asking for money. But I made the decision not to take contributions from corporate PACs, and we cannot afford to get out-spent again. Especially not when we lost by just 546 votes in 2022.
You see, these fundraising emails are the only way grassroots-funded campaigns like ours can compete with the Super PACs.
I know they can get annoying – especially if you’re hearing from a lot of campaigns. So if you need to unsubscribe, I understand. [**But if you can afford to give $5 to help me win this critical House seat, tonight would be a really good moment to chip in to my campaign.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83100415/467304632/1610638071?refcode=em20240415pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=ab1852d2-8afb-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYjE4NTJkMi04YWZiLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dgo-m8NqdGEfFERg7Zxs-uCYllPpneEJnYkNCifoGpA=)

We drove Lauren Boebert out of the district and running scared. But now, this race is going to get even harder. Her extreme Washington allies have already started attacking me.
All of the political pundits got this race wrong last time. Nate Silver’s FiveThirtyEight said we would lose by over 45,000 votes. But this time, they’re all saying we can win.
We cannot afford to miss this goal – not if we want to win this critical House seat. But I am relying entirely on grassroots donors like you, so I need your help.

name: Hillsdale College via American Briefing
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zor6g15ru0gak70g0bsvvegk5nesrrvsqbjr18f0_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9im9o71cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ze4ab2a7usdjc2s7giqjtci3pdfk8ufg585lm79g_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9im9o71cjh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z03e5ge2032ejaeeuvdejh0r6u0o9ug8j5bjgdkg_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9im9o71cjh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
---

body:
Strike out Adam Schiff

Dear Friend,

**_[Will you help me save California (and America) from crime, squalor, and Adam Schiff?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c690831%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2b6PkW08u7zCMiGopC6uQew&sysid=1) _**

Schiff already has three strikes against him:

He is a career-politician (since 1996). **Strike One.**

He lied to 300 million Americans and was censured by Congress for "falsehoods, misrepresentations and abuses of sensitive information" in his capacity as chair of the House Intelligence Committee.**Strike Two.**

He is the handpicked candidate of Joe Biden and Chuck Schumer. **Strike Three.**

**_[So, I’ll ask again, will you help me defeat Adam Schiff on November 5th?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c690832%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=J6%2bxQ76DIQpQEXDomgxPUw&sysid=1)_**

I can think of only one thing worse than being forced to endure six more years of crime, inflation, illegal immigration, and failing schools...

...and that’s being forced to endure six more years of Adam Schiff lying to our faces, pulverizing our Constitution, and abusing his power and office to attack his political enemies.

I’m counting on your support to help me defeat Adam Schiff in November, friend.

It’s time to reverse course and restore California to its rightful role as the heartbeat of America.

God Bless,
Steve Garvey #6

| | |

MANAKIN SABOT, VA -- 100% Pro-Trump 5th Congressional District candidate, former Navy SEAL, Virginia Senator, and business owner John McGuire today announced that he raised $325k in the first quarter of 2024.

McGuire has now out-raised Never Trumper Bob Good in both quarters since entering the race -- despite the fact that McGuire was at the Capitol delivering for the people for 60 days of the fundraising quarter.

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zogr4g2h8fpltn7s4dv7apk1cqnes3ivsmkqrt18_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9hmcob1cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zpva372pgv52helsquobhe6itob4et98l4oo64v0_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9hmcob1cdh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zjv7thfr0hg6lcm6vdrgf9esqh86jf61id0jadpo_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9hmcob1cdh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
---

subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z106iq5qdfj7aucf7laujuskc6i6ouqk7udv7dkg_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9hmaoj2cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrlko5g740j1oveuhqcugr602f3db9m73tug0qg8_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9hmaoj2cdh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2cgkb0injcop9d5bp624p9q67pspn4pgl3rof1o_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9hmaoj2cdh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Hillsdale College vai American Action News
subject: Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3c391891uub18cmba68j2e29ass83stk7inabmg_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9hmeo30cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2p7r2daef0dirho9f8fggmfddeb49rlemmkr168_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9hmeo30cjh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. body:
It's a win-win scenario

Dear Concerned American,

Your petition to Senate Minority Leader Mitch
McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your Senators, and your
Congressman is linked below.

It's vital that you submit your petition
immediately.

Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, Joe
Biden, and the Big Labor bosses are about to go ballistic.

I have introduced the National Right to Work
Act to repeal forever Big Labor's power to force workers to pay
union dues in order to work.

So the union lobbyists, Chuck Schumer, Hakeem
Jeffries, and their allies are going to use every trick in the
book to bury the National Right to Work Bill.

And they want to do it as quietly as
possible.

The union kingpins (and their water-carriers
in Congress) can't afford the consequences of having their
coercive privileges publicly debated and voted on in Congress!

They don't want the American people to know
that:

*** Millions of workers are forced to
surrender part of every paycheck to keep their jobs.

This cash funds violent "organizing" drives,
a limousine lifestyle for union bigwigs, and bankrolls radical,
tax-and-spend politicians like Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and
Hakeem Jeffries.
*** Big Labor's power is deadly to millions
of small businesses.

Big Labor politicians and stacked bureaucrats
are strangling small businesses with confiscatory taxes,
destructive laws, and straitjacket regulations.
*** Forced unionism exports millions of good
jobs overseas.

Productivity-killing work rules, workplace
class warfare, slowdowns, "sick-outs," and strikes all take their
crippling toll, closing the doors of many businesses -- for good.
In the fight to force votes on a National
Right to Work law, opponents of forced unionism will face a
showdown against the full might of Big Labor.

That's why it's vital that you act at once to
ignite massive public support for a National Right to Work Bill.

Now is the time to act.

By the time the Right to Work Bill comes up
for a vote, every member of Congress must realize the eyes of the
American people will be watching.

National opinion polls all show that 80% of
the American people agree it's wrong to force workers to pay
union dues under the threat of being fired if they don't pay!

And the National Right to Work Committee, who
has led the fight against forced dues for over 50 years, must
have your help in demonstrating that to Congress.

If the public's attention is fixed on this
battle, Congress will be forced to recognize -- or defy to its
peril -- the massive public opposition to compulsory unionism.

Then we'll see who dares to stand with Big
Labor. . .

. . . and who stands with freedom and the
American people.

It's vital you click to submit your petition
to Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your Senators,
and your Congressman immediately to demonstrate to Congress and
the national media the strong support for Right to Work.

It's all part of the National Right to Work
Committee's four-part plan to pass a National Right to Work law:

*** Contact directly by mail up to 10 million
supporters, urging them to demand their Senators and Congressmen
vote for the National Right to Work Bill;
*** Brief personally the hundreds of
favorable columnists, radio talk show hosts, and editorial
writers nationwide who can help mobilize public opinion;
*** Deploy digital advertising through email
and across social media in the days before the vote to really
make Congress feel the heat; and
*** Run TV and radio ads targeting swing
votes in key states and districts.
It is critical in this battle that Congress
hears loud and clear from the nearly 80% of Americans who support
Right to Work.

Of course, Congress may choose to obey Big
Labor bosses rather than the majority of their constituents.
That's their choice.

But time and again, when politicians defied
the public and voted for forced unionism, they've paid the price
with the end of their political careers!

Of course, this whole effort will be very
expensive.

An all-out media and direct-mail blitz to
mobilize massive public pressure on Congress will be the key to
our success.

To pay for the expensive ads, mailings, and
other efforts, it's urgent you send a special contribution to the
National Right to Work Committee today.

Will you make a generous contribution of
$1,000, $500, $250, $100, or $50 to launch the next, crucial
phase for ultimate passage of a National Right to Work law?

It's vital you act immediately to put the
politicians' feet to the fire to bring the National Right to Work
Act up for a vote.

It would be a crime to let politicians who
support compulsory unionism off the hook.

Up against the forced-dues fed,
billion-dollar might of Big Labor, all the Committee has on its
side is truth, public opinion. . .

. . . and you!

Unlike Big Labor, the National Right to Work
Committee doesn't have (or want) the power to force anyone to pay
dues.

So it has to depend on generous folks like
you.

Please don't make it easy for Chuck Schumer,
Hakeem Jeffries, Joe Biden, and Big Labor to bury the National
Right to Work Bill.

Some folks have already sent $500, $1,000,
and even more. For others, a contribution of $50 or $100 has been
as much as they could afford.

Please submit your petition so we can
demonstrate to Congress and the media the strong support for
Right to Work.

Without your contribution of $1,000, $500,
$250, $100, or $50, the National Right to Work Committee won't be
able to contact 10 million Americans, place the advertising,
deploy the whole digital program, or do anything else to put Big
Labor on the spot with a public vote on the National Right to
Work Bill.

And if you and I don't press forward now, we
may never have a chance like this again.

Please help today.

Be sure to submit your petition to Senate
Minority Leader Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your
Senators, and Congressman, and then give your contribution of
$1,000, $500, $250, $100, or $50 to the National Right to Work
Committee.

Sincerely,

Rand Paul
United States Senator

Work Bill is Big Labor's (and their water-carriers' in Congress)
worst nightmare!

and then pitch in with your contribution of $500, $250, $100, or
$50 to the National Right to Work Committee today.

name: Greater Georgia
subject: GREATER GEORGIA RELEASES ANALYSIS OF GEORGIA’S 2024 PRESIDENTIAL PRIMARY RESULTS
body:
| | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, APRIL 16
GREATER GEORGIA RELEASES ANALYSIS OF GEORGIA'S 2024 PRESIDENTIAL PRIMARY RESULTS
ATLANTA - Today, Greater Georgia released key findings from an analysis of voter data from the state's Presidential Preference Primary, held March 12, 2024. The data revealed signs of promise for the conservative movement, which is backed by voter enthusiasm, growing support from diverse communities, and an influx of new voters - including 7,000 first-time voters and 30,000 crossover voters.
"The Greater Georgia analysis shows both progress and room for growth," said Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler. "It is no surprise that conservatives have the enthusiasm advantage going into November, given the failed Biden agenda that has depressed turnout in Democratic primaries across the country. And although we also see signs of new support from minority, first-time, and crossover voters on the Republican side, 2024 will ultimately be about turnout. That's why we will continue to mobilize voters in support of conservatives up and down the ballot, to promote opportunity, security, and freedom."
More than 588,000 voters participated in Georgia's Republican presidential primary compared to the 290,000 who participated in the Democratic presidential primary.
In the Republican primary, women made up 52% of the electorate. While white voters made up the majority of the electorate at 95%, more Asian and Hispanic voters pulled a Republican ballot than a Democratic ballot. In fact, Hispanic voters represented a larger share of the Republican primary electorate in 2024 than in 2020, indicating growing support within the Latino and Hispanic communities.
Most of the Republican electorate comprised those who had pulled a GOP ballot in all or most primary elections. But 30,000 Republican voters, or 5% of the Republican electorate, were either split-primary voters, majority Democratic primary voters, or exclusively Democratic primary voters. These 30,000 voters were more likely to be rural, nonwhite, and lower-income citizens. Notably, nearly 7,000 first-time voters participated in the Republican primary - compared to just 3,000 first-time voters in the Democratic primary.
Democrats, meanwhile, saw a dramatic decrease in turnout for the presidential primary compared to 2020, when about 800,000 more Democrats voted. This year's Democratic electorate was 64% women, 65% black, and 52% over the age of 65. Fewer Hispanic, Asian, and first-time voters participated in the Democratic primary compared to the Republican primary. 6,000 voters left their ballots blank.
The lack of enthusiasm reflected in the Democratic primary is consistent with the [poll](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001PXypC_VPLLQk0uP_nvqwISJ4LU4hlyiCCJfqO1ByYrNGCIFTWlfw1u44fGw-5NZna_NHtZi6MWJvB4Y7aEWKcRd_MQ39NWzwP5eW9ZWN_YD_ySovIGZnR6Yw4OOmwEvwCmWP1r0JoNd6jkTGjDBNfFYXuU9ZH7AR46P2yxgBcQuT9czfr6U2NyrowpfVwgrJaNeeuipYfHCCRci43_Xc8IFzHCGvig4iQMTmwLvdIFXNihL8GaWACw==&c=yabhKZCHB891QcCZTij5-xSEmJCtl_0H5KdgAKam6dRowdivShRNvA==&ch=Lw0IZYNM7aeIepQmLkZhLz4ugzDBU8owJBrN0kgp4B_gvYUuLA9ZMw==) conducted by Greater Georgia earlier this year, which found that 57% of likely Georgia voters had an unfavorable opinion of Joe Biden.

clean_body: | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, APRIL 16 GREATER GEORGIA RELEASES ANALYSIS OF GEORGIA'S 2024 PRESIDENTIAL PRIMARY RESULTS ATLANTA - Today, Greater Georgia released key findings from an analysis of voter data from the state's Presidential Preference Primary, held March 12, 2024. The data revealed signs of promise for the conservative movement, which is backed by voter enthusiasm, growing support from diverse communities, and an influx of new voters - including 7,000 first-time voters and 30,000 crossover voters. "The Greater Georgia analysis shows both progress and room for growth," said Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler. "It is no surprise that conservatives have the enthusiasm advantage going into November, given the failed Biden agenda that has depressed turnout in Democratic primaries across the country. And although we also see signs of new support from minority, first-time, and crossover voters on the Republican side, 2024 will ultimately be about turnout. That's why we will continue to mobilize voters in support of conservatives up and down the ballot, to promote opportunity, security, and freedom." More than 588,000 voters participated in Georgia's Republican presidential primary compared to the 290,000 who participated in the Democratic presidential primary. In the Republican primary, women made up 52% of the electorate. While white voters made up the majority of the electorate at 95%, more Asian and Hispanic voters pulled a Republican ballot than a Democratic ballot. In fact, Hispanic voters represented a larger share of the Republican primary electorate in 2024 than in 2020, indicating growing support within the Latino and Hispanic communities. Most of the Republican electorate comprised those who had pulled a GOP ballot in all or most primary elections. But 30,000 Republican voters, or 5% of the Republican electorate, were either split-primary voters, majority Democratic primary voters, or exclusively Democratic primary voters. These 30,000 voters were more likely to be rural, nonwhite, and lower-income citizens. Notably, nearly 7,000 first-time voters participated in the Republican primary - compared to just 3,000 first-time voters in the Democratic primary. Democrats, meanwhile, saw a dramatic decrease in turnout for the presidential primary compared to 2020, when about 800,000 more Democrats voted. This year's Democratic electorate was 64% women, 65% black, and 52% over the age of 65. Fewer Hispanic, Asian, and first-time voters participated in the Democratic primary compared to the Republican primary. 6,000 voters left their ballots blank. The lack of enthusiasm reflected in the Democratic primary is consistent with the == conducted by Greater Georgia earlier this year, which found that 57% of likely Georgia voters had an unfavorable opinion of Joe Biden. | Greater Georgia, launched by former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler in 2021, is a 501(c4) nonpartisan nonprofit dedicated to growing participation in the democratic process by mobilizing and empowering voters. name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/_b5dscQbOk59BdswHuc1qQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoAOP-P0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9U0FMX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDQxNlcDc3BjQgpmEDRJHmZr_xGDUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/_b5dscQbOk59BdswHuc1qQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoAOP-P0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9U0FMX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDQxNlcDc3BjQgpmEDRJHmZr_xGDUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/_b5dscQbOk59BdswHuc1qQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoAOP-P0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9U0FMX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDQxNlcDc3BjQgpmEDRJHmZr_xGDUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

## Jury Selection Begins in Trump Trial
Day one of former President Donald Trump's [so-called hush-money](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAQAL_G7ojMsoBdUFyTLtdeaa1hiYmwsTBJlL8_5dWvHE0zmn-3-UYpp_3-lzZ2LZaZfEsvnlFIIwBn7IOLzMCqZyetVGBRG-hXZ7ynMQQCy0tU3uIiJRHIYVqQeYI-ORgAB5RmmLRR9kLLYqWVaKIeo1Ghw4FDaqVeHiXtbeWYP-XF9eLL1me3tnacnfrTwbWDKx07v8-v-kJtyWfu4NrqczvE-jxXsZWdP6LVRFk8nvUjTs7sWyq7GAONVk9KA9px4ZFjDCpoq5CIlea-unC8U87pNLbD4b5Ryj8Z7dcp_wMAAP__abhjTg) trial ended Monday with no jurors selected, but it featured numerous requests by both the defense and prosecutors. The [first 96 potential jurors](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FugzAQQL_GbEb4fJyTwUMXtnTtiAw-kosMjrATlL-v0rnbk97w9H4u4yVIku36HVb2dcljmKu8eERtSAOO2ES_MAPbhr1xxoLDnqC5eTKdiefAGCbuwTEanhYiOluMlk62EQ8dYIeGunNP1rVhmpxxBmnpTwvZqLDjKDXv7T3LVm-8pHd-8d7OeW2Sv9X6KMp-KRgUDMdxtPNUNj7KxysYPqhgqPtzfei6S0h64qtsRdccw1vfn_tbF048V8mbgqHZfXwckpIUcgq76xok_cXqv-u_AQAA__9OFFtl) from a pool of several hundred New York residents were sworn in just after 2 p.m. Judge Juan Merchan dismissed more than half after they indicated they could not be fair and impartial. Judge Merchan also [denied a request for Trump](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvhSAUhX8NbrzIBcEODF3cXteOBuXypEEwcvXFf9_YuctZTvLlnO_7OT5dTDG_vtyKlkIZ3UzxxFFxoTmoUTXeBkRA2aAVRkgwqtPQLLbTOPdBKtf3XZDgJxEkBEQDOHs5QRMttKBaJXT70WlpHm6ajDBC6dD1QUvPVIs-UtkfPyVmWjCkq5y4P-ayNskuRFtl8pPBwGDI11Yq3RWD4QYzGNo7RMdgOCrP-K4MBtqPdat8OerC15Lx4vmaOe3RJZ7iifzYvCOsfMf7asmVb0uhUrnLLl013pBmt357x5Ri1Yap9rW6mP5m0b-SfgMAAP__PnNpYA) to attend arguments on presidential immunity at the Supreme Court next week and delayed a decision for Trump to attend his son's high school graduation. The former president described the trial as political persecution in comments made after the court convened.
## Israeli Officials Meet to Plan Response
Israeli military officials met Monday and discussed [a potential response](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAUAL8GNlvweIA9MHTJlq4dLQyPmAqbyEZB_fsqnbveSSfd1325-1zy8fj0O7mW6uJDyy9acJBmAFyQR5eIgBQnJ61UYFEb4JubMM4kZAiUiFZvdBJBy-B18mgVJJ4dCECB0ohZG2VHv65WWokm6SkZFRkKirnVc_yu-WgbpfJTX3SOoe68uK2158XUB4Mbg1vvfVzX8HYMbgf16w3rWeKw5xgLDeSvNphpAjHrmZ8uPnsuJV_GMhSP3efyF27_bv4GAAD__6MsUy0) to Iran's unprecedented drone and missile attack. Iran launched hundreds of drones, ballistic missiles, and cruise missiles at Israel Saturday in response to a suspected Israeli strike in Syria two weeks ago. Israeli air defenses and warplanes, in coordination with the U.S.-led coalition of partners, [reportedly destroyed 99%](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAQAL_G7ohgvQa7cHFNulx7pbXAOtk7DBGgRPf3T3n1K0fTjObPbb-RJMn333Ty1o-yU-jy4h2VsQpwxzFuBzPwNPJmnJnA4WxhfGyewBsDKx644AIOo9fzHFeIS5i9XUbZQANqNFavs53chbx3xhm0x7wcdooDao7SS738LZL7g4_0v7y4XkI5x7Q9en-2Yfo1wHWAKz0zv9tHfaB2CYkHuJ4SmVpXnXOTkpuSVomTkkpZxVoyK-qdwj9FHCYLzmtvVo8QAx1hWcmhXmKA1Y51i8-3pCTNugH1_SRJ3yn9xzFfAQAA__8KHGOo) of the drones and missiles. At the conclusion of Monday's meeting, Israel's military chief Lieutenant[ General Herzi Halevi](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGnsTcsA2cwA0OXbOna0bqEI7kW4whoUN6-aufuv_Tr-zhvZ-TE-faOO_kWjw2vjZ-0gZBGKNhgDD4SKdIjeWmlVhYWo8a7d9o6XMEpGS4xrusCxhpAQ9Fh0DKO7NWsYAZpZrcYbSe8XKy0Ekxc1mh0GGCmwO0o0-fBud0pptfxpDJdj31M_t7aow76bVCnQZ1671OmXjvR128wqBPXgpTEzokblpfgWr-pikxddCyZ801wwSzk6uZl0WPx4dE5Ja7GDjDfduT092r_yn8CAAD___ImWo0) said the recent attack would be "met with a response." However, Halevi did not provide details, only saying Israel is still considering several plans. Despite describing the commitment to Israel as "ironclad," the Biden administration urged Israeli restraint and said the [U.S. wouldn't "participate ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAUAL8Gb1jwwJAMDF28pWtHC_Bz_FpiLKBB_fsqnbuddMNJ93Fbbp4SHfd3_0DXtrz42OiJi-bScNCLHla3IQKqAZ20UoHVk4FhdyFEoaLXV7vFaVUXO10FCBFAGkSc4kAOBGihpRHXySg7-hCstFKbbbpsRq1MC1yp5TJ-Zjrajlv6yU8sY8yPIbm9tbMy9cZgZjD33scY6oG9vjyD-YUMZqrFY-JU_MELnoWqT7y2Ql_I-04N-Z6_K_JAKx4M5qG49eyUElVjmRb3h6f0l2z_DvgNAAD__8J6Xcw)in a reprisal strike on Iran."
## FBI Investigates Baltimore Bridge Collapse
Federal authorities have [opened an investigation](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uwyAUxfGnwRsWX4Z4YOjiLV07WoAvyW0xWEBj5e2rVB27_aXfcnQ-ruvVYcJ8e3c72B7L6kLHB6yKck2FWtWw2QggQA5gueFSGDVpMdytYy54HqcQohRKs_kFWwSlZzHLEAe0ggnFFNdsnrQ0o_PecMOVjtMlarkRxWDDXur4WTD3O8T0LA-oYyj7kOy996MR-UbEQsRynueYfchwtpcTsbySiOW70b-KHmk5IDcaKu6YXaJHLR5orC4HbLSF0jv9gif1Fbcb0FBSckcD6l3quJcKtIbsuDIXLodqt-PElLBpQxS77Q7T77b-71M_AQAA__8vLmxq) into the cargo ship that crashed into Baltimore's Francis Scott Key Bridge, causing the bridge to collapse into the Patapsco River. Officials from the Justice Department [acknowledged the presence of FBI agents](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwyAYAJ8Gb1j8GeKBoYu3dO1oYfhwvhZDBCiW375K524n3XK6r_t6d5gw75_uANtjWZ3v-IJVUa6pUKsago0AAuQAlhsuhVGTFsPDGs2ECsqbOM_Cs1kyc9OcTYGpKcp5HtAKJhRTXLN50tKMbtsMN1zpON2iloEoBgF7qeN3wdwfENNVXlBHX44h2Ufvz0bkBxELEct5nqPfWoazvT0RyxuJWGJ12WOjzZfe6Q9cdKsYdqC-pOSeDSjmF7SOu-tYMo0b0sPVK7kcqOu91AxXoyVG9EDEMlQbniemhE0both-OEx_Sf3fQb8BAAD__42BaTU) on the cargo ship Dali but refused to provide further information. The investigation appears to be separate from existing probes being conducted by the National Transportation Safety Board and the Maryland U.S. Attorney's Office. The Associated Press also learned Monday that [the Dali experienced electrical problems](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2PozAQQH8NdI7s8SeFi2vS5dor0WCPyZwMRmAl2n-_ytZbPr3m6f17zA_kyvv6FzeKvbQZU-cXzUYoJ8DMZsyxEAHpkaLySoM31sH4jOALhJySK9kkTJOdQiYdwHmj0SUcOYIEI41ycrJO-xsui1deGVdsKE7nwUjK3Nt5-994708q9au96Lylto01Pns_rkH_GeA-wB2Pnd7XR33g7JwqDXBfsHbe2kliOTmvJFKrFY-LRFlY8P6iqzOu2LntwgYVQrZgpLbJWxc8OKmltUXLKfkwnjEfb66VL-cHI9cNuf7U9F_ffAcAAP__n9Jj-w) hours before the crash that killed six members of a road repair crew.

VIRGINIA GENERAL ASSEMBLY RECONVENES
TOMORROW NOON
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 17

| Friends, Tomorrow is a big day. The Virginia General Assembly returns to Richmond for Reconvene, also called Veto Session beginning at noon. You can watch online from the comfort of your own home by clicking the link below.
Governor Youngkin has set the new record, vetoing more bills in one year than any other Virginia governor, at 153 vetoes out of 1,046 bills. The Governor has soundly rejected the Democrat's tax and spend agenda that raises taxes on every Virginian.
With only a one member majority in each house, it is unlikely that the Democrats will be able to override any of Governor Youngkin's vetoes.
That said, word is that the Democrat controlled legislature plans to take up all of Governor Youngkin's amendments in a block and veto them.
I anticipate a stand off that will include a battle over the budget. The Democrat controlled legislature wants to increase taxes on every Virginian. Governor Youngkin is opposing and vetoing legislation that would raise taxes on every Virginian.
Governor Youngkin has offered 233 amendments to bills passed by the Democrat controlled General Assembly and signed 777 bills into law.
Here is the final list of bills Governor Youngkin has vetoed or amended. If you want more detail about a particular bill, just click on the tab for veto, sign or amend.
Included in this weekly newsletter is a list of important dates for upcoming primaries and elections. Please mark your calendar.

The Virginia General Assembly returns to Richmond for Reconvene, also called Veto Session beginning at noon. You can watch online from the comfort of your own home by clicking the link below. Governor Youngkin has set the new record, vetoing more bills in one year than any other Virginia governor, at 153 vetoes out of 1,046 bills. The Governor has soundly rejected the Democrat's tax and spend agenda that raises taxes on every Virginian. With only a one member majority in each house, it is unlikely that the Democrats will be able to override any of Governor Youngkin's vetoes. That said, word is that the Democrat controlled legislature plans to take up all of Governor Youngkin's amendments in a block and veto them. I anticipate a stand off that will include a battle over the budget. The Democrat controlled legislature wants to increase taxes on every Virginian. Governor Youngkin is opposing and vetoing legislation that would raise taxes on every Virginian. Governor Youngkin has offered 233 amendments to bills passed by the Democrat controlled General Assembly and signed 777 bills into law. Here is the final list of bills Governor Youngkin has vetoed or amended. If you want more detail about a particular bill, just click on the tab for veto, sign or amend. body:
| | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: April 16, 2024
---
| Contact: Mark Warner mark@ascent-strategic.com; 317-417-7556
---
| POLITICAL NEWCOMER JAMISON CARRIER OUTRAISES FIELD IN IN-06
---
| Greenwood, IN \- Campaign finance reports for the first quarter of 2024 were filed yesterday with the Federal Election Commission in the race for Indiana's 6th Congressional race. According to the reports, political newcomer and businessman Jamison Carrier outraised the entire GOP field, including a 10-year sitting State Senator, 14-year sitting State Representative, and a former Indianapolis City Councilor and Mayoral candidate.
---
| | Candidate | Money Raised
---|---
Jamison Carrier | $104,180.06
State Senator Jeff Raatz | $82,930.01
State Representative Mike Speedy | $39,465.00
Jefferson Shreve | $0
| Senior Advisor Kory Wood Statement:
"The momentum behind Jamison Carrier's campaign is growing by the day. Jamison has never run for office, was only in the race for six weeks, and impressively raised six figures in that period, more than the rest of the GOP field. This signifies the tremendous amount of support Jamison has across our district and shows voters are looking for a true political outsider to fight for them in DC."
In addition to money raised, Jamison Carrier also has the second most cash on hand; Jefferson Shreve has $1,488,164.66, Jamison Carrier has $739,238.42, State Representative Mike Speedy has $658,274.72, and State Senator Jeff Raatz has $73,587.73.
---

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 4/16/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.
| |
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| Howdy friends, Who else is happy Tax Day has passed? Just in case you missed it, [here's what you should do](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, April 16, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
# TODAY'S TOP STORIES
---
[**Douglas, El Paso counties name Gov. Polis as defendant in ‘sanctuary state’ suit**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
Elected commissioners and sheriffs in two central Colorado counties announced today they are [suing Gov. Jared Polis and the State of Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) related to Democrat-supported sanctuary state policies, which law enforcement has complained leaves it powerless to address illegal immigration. “There is an illegal immigration crisis in America,” [Douglas County Commissioner George Teal said in a statement](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). “We have been proactive, taking steps to mitigate the crisis here in Douglas County. What has been missing is the ability of our local law enforcement agencies to work with immigration officials. This is what we seek to solve through this legal action.” In fact, Douglas County claims it is the seventh step taken “to protect health and safety amidst the [national migrant crisis](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).” **[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

[**Bill banning so-called ‘assault weapons’ passed in House, headed to Senate**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Colorado House passed a bill banning "assault weapons," which is now [headed to the Senate for consideration](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Sponsored by Reps. Tim Hernandez and Elisabeth Epps, the bill [prohibits 13 types of "assault" weapons](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and defines them in state law, also banning "rapid-fire trigger activators."

* Supporters argued that the so-called "assault weapons" have no place in society, and that Colorado cannot wait for Congress to enact a federal ban. Critics countered that [the bill would ban 80% to 85% of guns in Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) — and it is, therefore, unconstitutional.

* Governor Jared Polis [expressed skepticism](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), preferring federal action, and amendments including penalties for gun dealers violating the ban.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**News organizations urge Biden and Trump to commit to presidential debates during the 2024 campaign**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Twelve news organizations, including ABC, CBS, CNN, Fox, PBS, NBC, NPR, and The Associated Press, urged Biden and Trump to [commit to debates during the 2024 campaign](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), emphasizing their importance as a tradition since 1976.

* Trump's campaign managers [affirmed his readiness to debate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), referencing historical debates and insisting on fair moderation. They also pushed for an earlier timetable due to early voting.

* Biden's campaign [did not directly respond to the letter](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), reiterating Biden's stance on Trump's behavior. However, Trump displayed a symbolic empty lectern at a rally, calling on Biden to debate anytime, anywhere.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Funeral home owners, found with nearly 200 decomposing bodies, now charged with COVID fraud**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado funeral home owners Jon and Carie Hallford, already facing charges for abuse of a corpse and other offenses, are now being accused of [fraudulently spending COVID relief funds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

* The couple allegedly used over [$880,000 in pandemic relief funds for extravagent personal expenses](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), including vacations, expensive retail shopping, cosmetic surgery, and cryptocurrency. Indictment reveals charges of 15 federal offenses, carrying potential penalties of 20 years in prison and $250,000 fines each.

* Prosecutors allege the Hallfords presented families with [concrete instead of cremated ashes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and failed to fulfill cremation and burial services, collecting over $130,000 for unfulfilled services.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**‘We must win the special election,’ Lopez tells Kit Carson Republicans, while supporting primary slate**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Greg Lopez is vying for the role of Congressman in Colorado's 4th District, seen by some as a [placeholder until the next election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

* He faces [Democrat Trisha Calvarese](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and Libertarian Hannah Goodman in the [special election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), aiming to finish the term of ex-Rep. Ken Buck. The 4th District, being red-leaning, presents a favorable landscape for a Republican candidate.

* Lopez highlighted [challenges faced by his Democratic opponent](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), suggesting internal party issues. Stressing the importance of winning the special election, Lopez urged Republicans to participate in both the [special election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and the upcoming [primary](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**COMMENTARY: Joe Biden’s signature achievement is his list of broken promises**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY HELEN RALEIGH, [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _President Joe Biden’s Energy Department canceled its plan to purchase millions of barrels of oil to refill the U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR). The cancellation means the Biden administration is unlikely to fulfill its promise of fully replenishing the SPR by the end of the year, and the SPR will remain at a historically low level after the administration depleted it in 2022._ _The depletion of the SPR was caused by the Biden administration’s own failed energy policy. Shortly after he came into office, President Biden issued a series of anti-fossil fuel energy policies, including canceling the Keystone XL Pipeline project and halting leasing on federal lands for oil and gas production. Biden’s energy policies strangled American energy production and supply and caused energy prices to soar. According to the Heritage Foundation, “from January 2021 to January 2022, crude oil prices increased 45 percent, blowing past records set in 2008. Gasoline and diesel prices are the highest on record since the Energy Information Administration started keeping track in 1993.”_ [**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️** **[Sen. Bob Gardner fails to qualify for ballot, he announces in letter to supporters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | APRIL 13** _State Sen. Bob Gardner has not qualified to appear on the Republican Party’s 5th District primary ballot for Congress, ending his campaign._ **[Sen. Rod Pelton warns Kit Carson Republicans of extreme gun bills, appointments](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | APRIL 13** _State Sen. Rod Pelton, R-Cheyenne, warned Kit Carson County Republicans gathered here Friday that they might stay on the lookout for a rash of bills coming through the upper chamber before the state’s legislative session is complete._ [**Sonnenberg qualifies for Republican Party’s primary ballot in 4th District race**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | APRIL 12** _Jerry Sonnenberg, who served 16 years in the Colorado legislature and most recently as a county commissioner, has qualified for the Republican Party primary ballot in the crowded 4th District field for Congress._ [**House Republicans welcome homeschooled students to the Capitol**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | APRIL 11** _An estimated one in 20 children is homeschooled in America, and in Colorado about 16,000 students claim to be homeschooled.__Some of those students and their parents visited the Capitol Thursday in celebration of Colorado Homeschool Day._ **Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming an RMV Contributor. Reply to this email (or reach out to [brian](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com)[@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com)) or send us a message on social media to chat!

Today, April 15, marks the **112th anniversary of the RMS Titanic sinking** in the early morning hours of April 15, 1912 in the North Atlantic Ocean. Read more about the tribute held at the Titanic Memorial [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

Don’t miss this virtual Earth Day event with RFK Jr. & Nicole Shanahan leading a panel discussing our planet’s future.

|

Dear Peter,
Join **Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.** and **Nicole Shanahan** on **April 22** for a virtual **Earth Day panel** where they will share **their vision for healthy people and a healthy planet.** [REGISTER HERE.](https://www.kennedy24.com/earth-day-virtual-fundraiser?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=virtual_earth_day_4_15_24_a4&n=3)
**Kennedy** has stated that he aspires to be the strongest environmental President since Teddy Roosevelt. He has long been one of the nation’s most influential environmentalists, bringing hundreds of lawsuits against corporate polluters and government agencies.
**Shanahan** is committed to regenerative agriculture and promoting soil health. She is the executive producer of the groundbreaking 2020 film “Kiss the Ground” and the just-released “Common Ground.”
| Date: Monday, April 22nd, 2024
---
Time: 3:00 - 4:15 PM EDT
Location: **Virtual Only**—[Register here](https://www.kennedy24.com/earth-day-virtual-fundraiser?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=virtual_earth_day_4_15_24_a4&n=4)
Panalists: Robert F. Kennedy, Jr., Nicole Shanahan, Vandana Shiva, Charles Eisenstein, Ryland Engelhart
Moderator: Stefanie Spear
Tickets: $24
[RSVP Now >> ](https://www.kennedy24.com/earth-day-virtual-fundraiser?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=virtual_earth_day_4_15_24_a4&n=5)
[This Earth Day event](https://www.kennedy24.com/earth-day-virtual-fundraiser?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=virtual_earth_day_4_15_24_a4&n=6) is being held hours before the first night of Passover, both of which celebrate the Earth, its renewal, and the coming of spring.
Kennedy and Shanahan will be joined by food sovereignty advocate and author **Vandana Shiva** , philosopher **Charles Eisenstein** , and co-founder of the non-profit Kiss the Ground **Ryland Engelhart**. EcoWatch founder **Stefanie Spear** will moderate the panel.
**This event is virtual only.** Once you register, **you'll receive a link via email on the day of the event** , granting you access to the virtual event.
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/earth-day-virtual-fundraiser?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=virtual_earth_day_4_15_24_a4&n=7)
See you there!

Your generosity enables me to traverse this massive district and show solidarity with our essential workers who are fighting the good fight. Thank you.

Friends,
Yesterday, my wife Peggy and I participated in a strike with local rural nurses and the Michigan Nurses Association in Sault Ste. Marie. They are protesting for equal pay to their regional colleagues and safe staffing levels.
My mother, sister, and numerous family members are all union nurses, not to mention the thousands of staff members I've worked with over the years.
I know it first hand - their dedication and hard work are crucial in ensuring positive patient outcomes and improving the health of our communities.
My team marched the entire afternoon. Peggy and I visited with a coffee cake, a personal donation and made a point to thank and talk to every picketer to gain a better perspective on their issues.
Rural healthcare is difficult. We need everyone to get on board to save it. I will always support the fight for essential human infrastructure like medical care and labor reform.
I'm hoping for a "win-win-win" solution for our nurses, rural hospitals, and our communities at-large.
It was an honor to stand shoulder to shoulder with MNA, Steelworkers, other unions, and our AFL-CIO Michigan president in solidarity.
Our rural communities depend on how well we care for our essential workers, and I will always show up to demand that we put hardworking people before profit.
Your support makes it possible. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
#SaveOurSoo
Thank you.
-Dr. Bob

Democrat, MI01
