body:
Republican in Registration Only?

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/7cc789d1b3a7/n41kepo7ku-12690931?e=25844e23a8)
https://ne.gop/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=d8fbe8fc70-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-d8fbe8fc70-21732365

** Good Morning Republicans,
------------------------------------------------------------
I'm a proactive planner, I try to be at least. I thrive when presented with obstacles/challenges and then conceptualize the means to achieve a vision to overcome said challenges. I also thoroughly enjoy being a part of a collective of like-minded, spirit-filled people making historical changes...changes that seemed unimaginable and unattainable because of the sheer forces against change. Change that so many said they wanted for the State party, but didn't envision what it would look like after, and simply placated and conformed to the status quo. Most people don't like change. They fear some part of "change" will be an overwhelming and irreversible failure that can never be recovered from. The public scrutiny will persist until the end of time. Others will see change as simply no worse nor better, but just a nuisance if change doesn't phenomenally improve a situation...so why bother?
Fortunately, there is one more group of people...the crazy-driven, hard-working, principle-based, constitutional faithful and faith-FILLED believers! These people see value IN change when a system has become conformed to societal norms that no longer match their values or principles. These Grassroots Mavericks rightfully use accountability to point out hypocrisy of values, false statements of "if I'm elected..." political narratives, and the compromising moral grayness that has eroded our Good Life culture through agendas. These visionary leaders have the long-term memory and perception of what made Nebraska and America great, but the emotional maturity to move forward when others want to cling to how people will "feel" about change. In politics, it is the most easily repeated trait watching leaders shy away from BOLDNESS even with common sense and support networks positively encouraging them to represent the people. Change that will further our PRINCIPLES is always a good and righteous
endeavor.
Yet, the concept of POWER...who has it and how much, will always be the obstacle to truly unifying on the principles or mission of an entity. Over the last two years I have gained context into the difference between power politics and an awesome political/cultural movement to what the people really desire - Value & Solutions Driven politics. This is the difference between having objectives of just winning elections for the sake of winning OR seeking to make a difference as an elected representative of, by, and for the people.
Even more obvious NOW is the detriment that comes from decades of the idea of being King-Makers versus Difference-Makers.
If the Objective of the Party was to just "elect Republicans", well...then those election WINS can be easily bought at a certain price, appointments given for incumbency head starts, and donor funds used by consultants more for retainers, creative content commissions, and win bonuses versus actual connections to voters. The success of this version of a party objective is ONLY based on the "Republican in Registration Only" winning, and not the results of their efforts in the elected office. Did they benefit society and listen to the will of the people with a servants heart?!? Always ask that question when looking at the big picture...watch this video from President Ronald Reagan and ask yourself Are you better off (https://youtu.be/rU6PWT1rVUk?si=ZzsfHIrtik5V2CyU&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=d8fbe8fc70-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-d8fbe8fc70-21732365) ?
Thankfully, the Objective of the Party IS to "maintenance the government of, by, and for the people...AND...to further our principles within the community." See, that's the difference between "electing Republicans" as the ENDGAME with no means or definition of "Republican" to achieve it versus one of the MEANS to maintaining the government of, by, and for the people AND furthering our principles is BY electing a clearly DEFINED Republican (I call them CPR's, Constitutional and Platform Republicans).
It's the Principles of the Party, the Platform as we call it, that always gets in the way of the "elect Republicans" objective. If we honor the platform FULLY, we MIGHT lose an election...at least that's what has been ceaselessly claimed as (un)verified data, but FEARFULLY driven into the Republican Voter psyche. The thought process that "We simply HAVE to compromise our Principles sometimes or we will LOSE the election, and you DON'T want that, do you Mr. or Mrs. Republican Voter??"
I've been reading the Platform over and over again, both the National (https://prod-static.gop.com/media/Resolution_Platform.pdf?_gl=1*l2dmny*_gcl_au*MTIxODMwMzAyMy4xNzA5MDA3OTU5&_ga=2.103797120.1458584079.1713242362-1209182457.1709007962&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=d8fbe8fc70-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-d8fbe8fc70-21732365) and State (https://ne.gop/issues/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=d8fbe8fc70-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-d8fbe8fc70-21732365) to aptly be able to communicate what makes a Republican, a Republican. I believe we have used too generic of principle references...Pro-Gun, Pro-Life, Pro-Capitalism, Less Government, Less Taxes, etc. or tried to find an adjective see New York Times Article (https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2023/08/17/upshot/six-kinds-of-republican-voters.html?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=d8fbe8fc70-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-d8fbe8fc70-21732365) (moderate, progressive, conservative, right-wing, populist, libertine or Libertarian Conservatives) this creates a sliding-door politician.
Registered Republicans of Nebraska want elected representatives of Republican Values, not politicians sitting idly by as the country crumbles around us. Not a "Today I'm Moderate, tomorrow I'm Conservative...Yesterday I was Bi-Partisan and tonight I'm Bi-Polar."
Election year..."I'm everything to everyone at all times and at no time, but non-election year I'm swinging for the fences or checking my donor scorecard to see who I'm supposed to dance with tonight at the ball."
The majority of the membership of registered Republicans in Nebraska want to be represented by a party that believes in THEM and clearly follows the rules of the Republican Party. Your party now represents the majority of Republicans in Nebraska. We have tried to create a Big Tent/Reagan model of 80% on Principles, but maybe President Reagan was making a reference to the process or procedure, the priority of action steps to achieve 80% success of all ideas versus finding a sliding scale 80% agreement on Principles.
"The person who agrees with you 80% of the time is a friend and an ally - not a 20% traitor" - President Ronald Reagan

Logically, you simply cannot create stability, nor unity, within ANY organization that has multiple sets of visions, missions, and objectives. Folks, I've looked. I've googled. I've tried to research a timeline that has EVER shown multiple Republican Party Platforms. There is not a Moderate Republican Platform, a Progressive Republican Platform, a Conservative Republican Platform, even those who want to evoke a dramatic eye-roll by calling it a Hard Right-Wing Republican Platform...there is ONE Republican Platform! It can be revised from time to time, but at extreme measures of consideration to the future and not for political compliance of a poll or survey response. Yes, there are subsequent State Platforms that should include State Right's prioritized principles, where laws and governing need specific focuses... like in Nebraska we reference "Winner-Take-All", or a heavier priority on Agriculture since its the lifeblood of Nebraska.
We have to think bigger than JUST to win ELECTIONS in 2024. We have to have objectives to achieve. Our 2024 Political Plan was specifically designed to create a new currency within the Republican party to achieve long term success. The currency and power of...YOU, the People.
I am so proud of the people of this party from Scottsbluff to Omaha who believed in the County GOP infrastructure as the new source of influence to maintain the government and further our principles. We are still gathering all the county delegate information, but at rough numbers we DOUBLED county convention turnout totals from 2022 numbers. We are approaching almost 4000 county delegates in 2024 and that's an ARMY of new volunteers, new leaders, new donors, new candidates, and this will translate into the greatest POWER source...NEW VOTERS!
This is why you DONATE (https://ne.gop/donate/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=d8fbe8fc70-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-d8fbe8fc70-21732365) to the County and State Party apparatus. This is why we become a NEGOP+ Booster member (https://secure.anedot.com/negop/negopplus?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=d8fbe8fc70-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-d8fbe8fc70-21732365) . This is why we pay Convention (https://secure.anedot.com/negop/convention2024?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=d8fbe8fc70-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-d8fbe8fc70-21732365) dues and attendance ticket prices (https://www.flynnmovie.com/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=d8fbe8fc70-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-d8fbe8fc70-21732365) . If done with clear objectives and a long-term vision of continued growth, STABILITY will happen in the party because people are UNIFYING on their values. Personalities will fade into the sunset as true leaders move FORWARD and no longer care about old wounds, hurt feelings, and titles.
I know you want your donations to have a CLEAR and understood return on the investment! This is why I spend much of my time educating and communicating the objectives of the party. This is why fundraising for the State and county party's from THE PEOPLE will make a DIFFERENCE to achieve our objectives. WE, all members who support the objectives of the NEGOP...with your help we will be difference-makers in our communities. Your connection to CHANGE and your chance at being a part of history lies right here, with the NEGOP!
Together, we will make Nebraska greater than it's ever been.

Our State Convention is May 18th (https://ne.gop/convention2024/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=d8fbe8fc70-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-d8fbe8fc70-21732365) and we have an awesome Featured Speaker - Lt. General Michael Flynn! We will be showing his movie "Flynn - Deliver the Truth. Whatever the Cost." on Friday night, May 17th including a Q&A session

FLYNN Movie Premiere Tour
Friday, May 17^th Lincoln, NE
5:00pm Doors open
5:00pm – 6:15pm Meet & Greet
6:30pm Movie starts
8:30pm Q&A session
9:00pm Event ends
https://www.flynnmovie.com/showing/flynn-movie-premier-lincoln-ne/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=d8fbe8fc70-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-d8fbe8fc70-21732365 (https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=1a46cd6709&e=29f1bbf6e5&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=d8fbe8fc70-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-d8fbe8fc70-21732365)

We have plenty of work to do with Legislation Support, support of candidates, connecting to coalition partners, event planning, and discussing the different committee's and groups need to be successful in 2024!
The truth shall set us free.
Blessings,
–Chairman Underwood

In recent years, the world of finance has been revolutionized by the advent of blockchain technology. At the forefront of this revolution is Ethereum, a decentralized platform that enables the creation of smart contracts and the execution of decentralized applications (DApps). We will delve into the world of Ethereum and smart contracts, exploring their potential to reshape the financial landscape as we know it.
**What is Ethereum?**
Ethereum, launched in 2015, is an open-source, blockchain-based platform that enables developers to create and deploy decentralized applications (DApps) and smart contracts. Unlike traditional platforms, Ethereum is not controlled by a central authority, making it a truly decentralized system. This feature allows for a trustless and transparent environment, where users can interact with each other without the need for intermediaries.
The native cryptocurrency of the Ethereum network is Ether (ETH), which is used to pay for the computational resources required to execute smart contracts and DApps. This process is known as "gas."
**What are Smart Contracts?**
Smart contracts are self-executing digital contracts that automatically enforce the terms of an agreement between parties. These contracts are written in code and stored on the Ethereum blockchain, ensuring that they are transparent, secure, and tamper-proof. Smart contracts can be used to automate a wide range of processes, from financial transactions to supply chain management.
One of the key advantages of smart contracts is their ability to eliminate the need for intermediaries, such as banks and lawyers. This not only reduces costs but also increases efficiency and reduces the potential for fraud. Additionally, smart contracts are immutable, meaning that once deployed, they cannot be altered or deleted. This ensures that all parties involved in the contract adhere to the agreed-upon terms.
**Applications of Ethereum and Smart Contracts:**
Ethereum and smart contracts have the potential to transform a wide range of industries, including finance, real estate, supply chain management, and more. Some of the most promising applications of this technology include:
1. Decentralized Finance (DeFi): Ethereum and smart contracts have paved the way for the creation of decentralized financial applications, such as lending platforms, decentralized exchanges, and stablecoins. These applications allow users to access financial services without the need for traditional intermediaries, making them more accessible and cost-effective.
2. Tokenization of Assets: Ethereum's ERC-20 and ERC-721 token standards enable the creation of digital tokens that represent real-world assets, such as real estate, art, and commodities. This process, known as tokenization, allows for fractional ownership of these assets, making them more accessible to a wider range of investors.
3. Supply Chain Management: Smart contracts can be used to improve the efficiency and transparency of supply chain management by automating processes such as tracking, invoicing, and payment. This not only reduces costs but also increases trust between parties, as all transactions are recorded on the blockchain.

Ethereum and smart contracts are at the forefront of a financial revolution that promises to disrupt traditional systems and create a more transparent, efficient, and accessible financial landscape. As the technology continues to mature and gain widespread adoption, we can expect to see even more innovative applications that have the potential to reshape the way we interact with each other and the world around us.

clean_body: | | This cycle, I'm centering my campaign around the phrase "Make Congress Work Again." Let me explain to you exactly what that means. America simply can't handle two more years of dysfunction in Congress. We can't handle two more years of empty speeches. We can't handle two more years of culture wars that get nothing accomplished except perpetuate hate and division. We can't handle rotating cast of far-right extremists performing a circus act for social media. We can't handle policy and inaction that hurts millions of Americans. Make Congress Work Again is about ending the dysfunction in Congress and ensuring our government is doing the hard work of actually providing for the people. That's what I'm all about. I hope you’ll join me in ending the dysfunction. Talk soon, Matt Diemer | Diemer for Congress P.O. Box 40042 Bay Village, Ohio 44140 | | | Sent via . | **$6**

More than 23,000 donations were made to my campaign in March with **an average gift of $6**. And let me tell you that while $6 goes a long way in helping us to reach the voters we need to continue winning elections - not as many people are donating to campaigns like mine as they once did.**In fact, our fundraising numbers are down 84% in the first 11 days of April compared to the first 11 days of March.**

This email is on the longer side, so if you don't want to read to the end, **[would you be able to make a contribution of $6](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=cf40ad346d184f0b9be116cba33a0fe3&_e=PnOY9F5SLtfQABbc2XA6F0kNhlqI6NiFgcpz7ZsWtxGGC5oUOG3WmNM-9FLMnMb_2tRYc18Cwv6wuy99jw5f5DLJF9qKSYCAYdG92vVlY3Rikhi01sHBzKEtKz3Hug6zn9RR7LsBDHoFi80bUI5sEJ20TOfm1WBQigRDbYfVeIAG5cLaPwNOdt68JY-1ivJPoR-YJN5P0MOle_LSWMV4z0Ipg9hGBJdsjJf3TlzQOH84qnWl5bcXlc0gvJRcR7JMZv0bTN-rsthvDLOLrVUvo7aWaJsCleYueneqP3bzahGHkhMokrZSwAYDSgeb0KrEMSyF2YmjR6d7kg4lIuiu0ZuTYlLyr924JBajEUbnrAceU4IQjZ5vyU_y-bYxhTmptHJJL7HHKUnCu_fdyCeWPA%3D%3D)** , our average March donation, to help us kick-start our april fundraising?

[**CHIP IN $6
**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=cf40ad346d184f0b9be116cba33a0fe3&_e=PnOY9F5SLtfQABbc2XA6F0kNhlqI6NiFgcpz7ZsWtxGGC5oUOG3WmNM-9FLMnMb_2tRYc18Cwv6wuy99jw5f5DLJF9qKSYCAYdG92vVlY3Rikhi01sHBzKEtKz3Hug6zn9RR7LsBDHoFi80bUI5sEJ20TOfm1WBQigRDbYfVeIAG5cLaPwNOdt68JY-1ivJPoR-YJN5P0MOle_LSWMV4z0Ipg9hGBJdsjJf3TlzQOH9Wi-GEa0pl-3cbXswSWtZ18AxlN1p280cTO8Cgvd9OHOQzEr6VsrCLOsnNaZbBsidMdhteTqk23AylixKMA6Ah8ptfMXjVDiWd6ax_OAF8_Mz_TNTJYcbeTHdjhR6gfKktJQsKo--n4giObGcaPHvDmqbgM5dDO0dVfQIuXH7_Ag%3D%3D)
Some political pundits have written articles that spell doom for Republican candidates, opining that conservative candidates/causes have inundated you with too many texts and too much email to sift through in a day. While It’s true that nearly every congressional campaign in the 2024 cycle will attempt to utilize online fundraising to propel them into the House/Senate, not every email or text is created equal; and **not every email or text will deliver the entirety of your donation to the candidate you think you’re donating to.**

Bad actors and political grifters have figured out that online fundraising is a good way to make a quick buck off your generosity. **Not me. Not now, not ever.**

I know a couple of things to be true:
* We must do everything within our power to hold onto the U.S. House – the future of our country absolutely depends on it

* **Democrats are outraising Republicans 2-1 most months, sometimes it can even be as high as 3-1**

That’s why I’m reaching out today. The stakes are as high now as they were in each of the past two elections, **[yet in just one month we've seen an 84% drop in donations](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=cf40ad346d184f0b9be116cba33a0fe3&_e=PnOY9F5SLtfQABbc2XA6F0kNhlqI6NiFgcpz7ZsWtxGGC5oUOG3WmNM-9FLMnMb_2tRYc18Cwv6wuy99jw5f5DLJF9qKSYCAYdG92vVlY3Rikhi01sHBzKEtKz3Hug6zn9RR7LsBDHoFi80bUI5sEJ20TOfm1WBQigRDbYfVeIAG5cLaPwNOdt68JY-1ivJPoR-YJN5P0MOle_LSWMV4z0Ipg9hGBJdsjJf3TlzQOH_8L-faUDvobvcQzTy-eWgbuzCHfVMPWtDILieX0ugbuuEFK1c-OfoqOeXTK0bN1IfKv8wJV7tD3Drvh0hSKus06QblsgQOhAhMrTpv-f0ehc8jzPXP_JT9FhvWexmksxDpLWGaP4xhRJSS7eEFm5UQfSPlhsMz_NrwcWlue-S-lQ%3D%3D)**. If you can, would you please help us close the donation gap by **[chipping in $6](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=cf40ad346d184f0b9be116cba33a0fe3&_e=PnOY9F5SLtfQABbc2XA6F0kNhlqI6NiFgcpz7ZsWtxGGC5oUOG3WmNM-9FLMnMb_2tRYc18Cwv6wuy99jw5f5DLJF9qKSYCAYdG92vVlY3Rikhi01sHBzKEtKz3Hug6zn9RR7LsBDHoFi80bUI5sEJ20TOfm1WBQigRDbYfVeIAG5cLaPwNOdt68JY-1ivJPoR-YJN5P0MOle_LSWMV4z0Ipg9hGBJdsjJf3TlzQOH8peaOgcJ5oF_WhAlaT4yskIxRiQQNIyobrxrq0z-LZUwMbUw_6_xrOu4HbjqYXD7Urs9vzlip9EmgsXccprRqeGGWpGUyM_YnO-1wGqeD9idgLPOD7jSgAHJ8OlFcPg1-Edif7ACTe4WuCtO2wre80c2e2ztYJiWxt1I06jXhiIQ%3D%3D)** or another amount today?

**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=cf40ad346d184f0b9be116cba33a0fe3&_e=PnOY9F5SLtfQABbc2XA6F0kNhlqI6NiFgcpz7ZsWtxGGC5oUOG3WmNM-9FLMnMb_2tRYc18Cwv6wuy99jw5f5DLJF9qKSYCAYdG92vVlY3Rikhi01sHBzKEtKz3Hug6zn9RR7LsBDHoFi80bUI5sEJ20TOfm1WBQigRDbYfVeIAG5cLaPwNOdt68JY-1ivJPoR-YJN5P0MOle_LSWMV4z0Ipg9hGBJdsjJf3TlzQOH95GH7YDVUiUKzRIVSIvVMQRorqS92DY-0oUxH_3F0JUYNCd8TwPy-2VyDscOakPns9YHH49pKx4y6vHJAn_NiDbZIEiM0EPt6FS7ysyzHWMynRsei_81DotLkbc6qfe_5sHhX-7ZwvkTD1tvwjOV-z0DzFWhqtcsVY18jHKbvndQ%3D%3D)
When considering whether to donate to campaign contribution requests like this one, I urge you to look at the paid for language at the bottom of the email. _**Do you know who you’re giving money to? It may not be the person asking for it**_.

With so much competition for your hard-earned dollars, campaigns like mine have seen a dramatic shift in the donations we’re able to bring in every month, **putting a damper on our efforts to keep our one-seat House majority**. So, if you’re able to at this time, would you please consider my request for a donation today? **[Whether it’s $5, $15, or the March average of $6, every contribution counts](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=cf40ad346d184f0b9be116cba33a0fe3&_e=PnOY9F5SLtfQABbc2XA6F0kNhlqI6NiFgcpz7ZsWtxGGC5oUOG3WmNM-9FLMnMb_2tRYc18Cwv6wuy99jw5f5DLJF9qKSYCAYdG92vVlY3Rikhi01sHBzKEtKz3Hug6zn9RR7LsBDHoFi80bUI5sEJ20TOfm1WBQigRDbYfVeIAG5cLaPwNOdt68JY-1ivJPoR-YJN5P0MOle_LSWMV4z0Ipg9hGBJdsjJf3TlzQOH9mWCpaKLLgNnrAML_APsGRq0M0pq90JUz1sPTLWHEbu_l3eiOCo002HmwBDLIZj79Pj4AyPXDySgEQOuuiKlUEj9PrfFu0cMz024S0U2n8ndDYWivDQd7PWt6iSo1a7NpNBy3PRDO87thYHsHF1fcR-Ev1UCqbHEKSM-gxTF9G8g%3D%3D)** - every single contribution matters.

The Crouch for Governor Campaign Ends First Quarter with $3.055 Million Cash on Hand—Most of Any Republican Candidate

https://vimeo.com/manage/videos/934974775?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=20d365b464-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_01_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-768b133d23-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Indianapolis, IND — Republican gubernatorial candidate Suzanne Crouch filed her campaign finance report yesterday and reported more than $3 million cash on hand heading into the final weeks of the primary race.

Crouch’s balance was more than the cash on hand figures for the other Republican gubernatorial candidates combined.

In fact, her opponents’ totals amount to less than $2 million.

“As I’ve said many times, unlike my opponents, I am not a self-funder,” said Crouch. “The encouragement and donations I’ve received during this campaign are truly humbling. I am so grateful to my supporters across Indiana.”

“Suzanne’s grassroots fundraising strength and statewide support mean we’ll have all the resources necessary to continue our conversation with Hoosier voters about eliminating taxes and addressing Indiana’s mental health crisis,” said Crouch campaign manager Liz Dessauer.

The fundraising numbers reported for the first quarter are just the latest indication that momentum is clearly on Suzanne Crouch’s side.

Since its launch in December 2022, the Crouch for Governor campaign has received public pledges of support from more than 160 grassroots leaders—including more than 20 past or present county sheriffs.

Additionally, Suzanne is the only candidate in the race for governor who has committed to eliminating Indiana’s individual income tax. As a result of her plan, the average Hoosier would save $2,000 annually in state taxes.

You can learn more about “Axe the Tax” here (https://crouchforindiana.com/axe-the-tax/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=20d365b464-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_01_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-768b133d23-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

###

To learn more about how Suzanne is the only conservative Republican fighting China, proposing an elimination of Indiana’s individual income tax, and casting the key votes to protect our most vulnerable Hoosiers, please visit her web site at www.crouchforindiana.com.

body:
(Everyone in Delaware is dead...) | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/b6972b5457c2/im-running-for-us-senate-14157937?e=dbd1068b05)
---

In February of this year, a drug sweep [resulted](https://voteerichansen.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=507adf5d727e502cde205c852&id=f87674adef&e=dbd1068b05) in the seizure of 11 pounds of fentanyl in a Philadelphia neighborhood - enough to kill every man, woman and child in Delaware two and a half time times.
In January, almost 400,000 doses of fentanyl, heroin and other drugs worth about $3.6 million were seized by authorities - also in Philadelphia. The criminals [were charged](https://voteerichansen.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=507adf5d727e502cde205c852&id=cb3da4b322&e=dbd1068b05) with running a widespread drug trafficking ring throughout southeastern Pennsylvania.
I don’t know about you, but these two recent examples hit a little too close to home for me. Fentanyl trafficking doesn’t stop at state lines. What happens in Philly can easily happen in Dover - or any other Delaware town.
**It has to end, and pretending like we don’t know the root cause of the fentanyl crisis in America is doing a great disservice to the people of our state.**
The drug epidemic here in Delaware is real. You know it. I know it. Delaware’s per capita fentanyl and opioid deaths are still among the worst in the nation. And while overdose deaths saw a small decline last year for the first time in a decade, [the reality is](https://voteerichansen.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=507adf5d727e502cde205c852&id=39531690f0&e=dbd1068b05) that four times more people are killed by drugs than by car crashes in Delaware.
**We need change. We need real problem-solvers to tackle this issue head-on. Career politicians just aren’t cutting it.**
When the party in power supports open borders and welcomes illegal immigration, what they’re really doing is inviting deadly drugs into our towns and communities. That’s just a fact. Fentanyl chemicals are shipped from China to Mexico, made into Fentanyl in Mexico, and then smuggled into the United States by drug cartels enabled by an administration that simply looks the other way.
For his entire presidency, Joe Biden has looked the other way when it comes to the crisis at the southern border. So has Congresswoman Lisa Blunt Rochester, my opponent in the race for the United States Senate. There’s no way around it.
**In Congress, Democrats have promoted open borders for years. My opponent even once said she supported turning Delaware into a sanctuary state.****And she thinks she deserves a promotion?**
**No.**
[Delaware needs new leadership. Real change. That’s why I’m running for the U.S. Senate: to fight for common-sense solutions to our state’s toughest problems. I’d be honored if you’d join me. ](https://voteerichansen.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=507adf5d727e502cde205c852&id=986082d0ab&e=dbd1068b05)
-Eric

clean_body: (Everyone in Delaware is dead...) | | | | | In February of this year, a drug sweep in the seizure of 11 pounds of fentanyl in a Philadelphia neighborhood - enough to kill every man, woman and child in Delaware two and a half time times. In January, almost 400,000 doses of fentanyl, heroin and other drugs worth about $3.6 million were seized by authorities - also in Philadelphia. The criminals with running a widespread drug trafficking ring throughout southeastern Pennsylvania. I don’t know about you, but these two recent examples hit a little too close to home for me. Fentanyl trafficking doesn’t stop at state lines. What happens in Philly can easily happen in Dover - or any other Delaware town. It has to end, and pretending like we don’t know the root cause of the fentanyl crisis in America is doing a great disservice to the people of our state. The drug epidemic here in Delaware is real. You know it. I know it. Delaware’s per capita fentanyl and opioid deaths are still among the worst in the nation. And while overdose deaths saw a small decline last year for the first time in a decade, that four times more people are killed by drugs than by car crashes in Delaware. We need change. We need real problem-solvers to tackle this issue head-on. Career politicians just aren’t cutting it. When the party in power supports open borders and welcomes illegal immigration, what they’re really doing is inviting deadly drugs into our towns and communities. That’s just a fact. Fentanyl chemicals are shipped from China to Mexico, made into Fentanyl in Mexico, and then smuggled into the United States by drug cartels enabled by an administration that simply looks the other way. For his entire presidency, Joe Biden has looked the other way when it comes to the crisis at the southern border. So has Congresswoman Lisa Blunt Rochester, my opponent in the race for the United States Senate. There’s no way around it. In Congress, Democrats have promoted open borders for years. My opponent even once said she supported turning Delaware into a sanctuary state.And she thinks she deserves a promotion? No. -Eric | | Go to learn more. | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | Copyright (C) 2024 Hansen For Senate LLC. All rights reserved.

Friends --
Yesterday my campaign submitted 30,000 signatures to officially put my name on the ballot for U.S. Senate.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-apr24.UpsRlZ&refcode=em240416-1-15&t=2&akid=1350%2E135344%2EViG2Gy)
Here in Michigan, you need 15,000 signatures in order to place your name on the ballot for U.S. Senate. But here on Team Slotkin, we like to go the extra mile -- so we decided to collect 30,000, the maximum number that the state permits a candidate to turn in. It’s a massive achievement, and a real sign of grassroots momentum.
First, and most importantly, I want to thank everyone who signed a petition or volunteered to help collect signatures—much like everything else in this campaign, it doesn’t happen without you. That includes a powerhouse volunteer group in Lansing that has helped me collect signatures in each of my elections since I first ran for office, as well as folks from all 13 Michigan congressional districts who put in the hours at farmers markets and community events all over the state.
Submitting our signatures and getting on the ballot is a big milestone in this race, and the unofficial start of a new phase in our campaign. The next one comes shortly after the April 23, 2024 filing deadline, when all of the signatures have been verified to confirm who officially makes the ballot. So I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support is so important in our success.
I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that knows this job is about serving your country, not serving yourself.
The truth is, we all know America is going through something right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple:
Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class.
Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security.
Like protecting our children from the things that are truly harming them.
And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream.
I believe most of us share those core values, and yesterday, with 30,000 of my fellow Michiganders by my side, we started down the path to proving it.
As one of just two open competitive seats and a must-win for Democrats to keep the Senate, our race is attracting a lot of attention from national Republicans, including Donald Trump. Over the next 7 months, the attacks will only get nastier, the scrutiny more intense, and the stakes more pressing.

Friend, my family has been built on the backs of generations of strong women. Will you let me tell you a bit about my family and how they've inspired me to run for the Senate?
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83120461/467365441/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1093-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWFiMWY4NmItZmNmYi1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=gAnTTtX76fjTv0-RJHvYV9CYGdFzZfKtx_MpH-F3LpY=)
My mother worked full-time to raise my older sisters and me. That was pretty uncommon in Ecuador back then. With my mom so busy (and never much of a cook anyways), my grandmother was the one who would come over and prepare meals for us. She was an amazing cook, and she was an even stronger woman.
I remember watching her cook some of the best meals I’ve ever had — and always being there when my sisters and I needed her. Her strength and her resilience have been passed down, from generation to generation.
When I was 14, my mother made the difficult but incredibly brave decision to bring my sisters and me to America. She worked so hard in those early days. I remember her taking on double shifts at work and somehow still fitting in English classes at night. All of us kids stepped up to help make ends meet and build a home in our new country. My older sisters were always there for me, too. When school got hard, when bullies made fun of my accent, or when teachers underestimated me because of my background, they always stood up for me — and taught me to stand up for myself.
**My grandmother, my mother, and my sisters taught me to work hard and never, ever give up.** Their sacrifices and courage are the reason why I was able to go to college, start a career giving back to my community, and eventually become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress.
They are the reason I was able to achieve my American Dream. **And now, I'm raising my daughters to live the same way — to follow their dreams and always stand up for themselves. But these days, the American Dream is out of reach for more and more families.** It's harder to get a good-paying job or afford a home. And our fundamental rights — to vote, to access health care, and so much more — are increasingly under attack.
That's why I'm running for Senate: **To give every family, here in Florida and across the country, the opportunities that mine had._And to help make it a bit easier for the next generation to achieve their American Dream._**
Look, polling data shows that my race is a statistical tie. But more than the numbers, I feel it in my bones that Florida is ready to flip blue. Families here are ready for a Senator who will listen to them and deliver results, not pull our communities apart. **[So please, if you believe in a future where we all can achieve our American Dream, will you donate $5 or whatever you can spare to help me flip Florida blue and fight for your family in the Senate? | Looking forward to talking with 1140 WRVA's Award Winning radio show host John Reid tomorrow morning at 8:05am.
Legislators return to Richmond tomorrow at noon for Reconvene, also called Veto Session. The standoff has already begun as Governor Youngkin has rightfully vetoed 153 out of 1,046 bills and offered 233 amendments to bills passed by the Democrat controlled General Assembly.
Offended by all of the vetoes, House Speaker Don Scott released an attack video on Twitter with false claims that Governor Youngkin is going to shut down the government. body:
In my time in Congress, I found what’s most challenging is money in politics. The truth is that it costs money to run for office, and it affects the kind of people who can step up and run for office.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83123128/467373759/41798106?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNTY1ZWM3OS0wMGZjLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CVgQhrllrBgC9tenwDnbYOrt6pGxry0JPN62nRi8ce0=&emci=7b2ba5ff-3afb-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&emdi=f565ec79-00fc-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ceid=26261389)
---

| | There's a reason I don't take a dime from corporate PACs: My vote is not for sale. In my time in Congress, I found what's most challenging is money in politics. The truth is that it costs money to run for office, and it affects the kind of people who can step up and run for office. In the last three elections, I've run against three straight self-funding candidates who have spent a lot of their own money to try and win this seat. Hello,
While I know our campaign sends a lot of emails your way, I want to take a few to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support is so important in our success.
The truth is, we all know America is going through something right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple:
Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class.
Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security.
Like protecting our children from the things that are truly harming them.
And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream.
I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets that we are public servants.
But my decision to run for Senate is also deeply personal to me, and it's related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018.
It's about my mom. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — motivated me to run then, and keeps me motivated to fight now. I remember the exact moment that I decided to enter public office: when the then-GOP controlled House of Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those protections for people with pre-existing conditions.
Six years later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare, repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate, then there’s the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation.
By winning this Senate seat, we can pass legislation that expands access to healthcare. Not the obsession with taking things away.
To be upfront: Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. And we have to do it without raising a single dollar from corporate PACs.
Donations 6 months from now – when we’re in the home stretch – are important. But donations now are even more important, because they allow us to map out a strategic plan and make decisions about when and how we reach voters.

name: Sarah DeValkenaere
subject: Why I’m asking for your help
body:
I wish I could sit down with you face to face instead of writing this e-mail.

Dear Friend,

I wish I could sit down with you face to face instead of writing this e-mail.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zudt9i68kn8cs9sqce04mor461nd01cnkr2uhdio_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9ieao74c5h2bs)
That's a picture of me and my husband, Eric, so you at least know what we look like.

Eric is a Detective with the Kansas City Police Department.

I wanted to send a picture of us with our three beautiful children - but in this current political climate, I don't feel safe sharing photos of our kids on the Internet.

When I tell you what happened, I think you'll understand. **[And I pray that you'll find it in your heart to help me save my husband.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zc10pu87jki26fmk48tr37g7vac5pn2tgqctcl3o_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9ieao74c5h2bs)**

You see, it all started in early December - a few weeks before Christmas.

One of Eric's fellow detectives witnessed two vehicles speeding through the city streets - one was clearly chasing the other - and the police helicopter quickly got involved. A spotter in the helicopter was able to locate the suspect in a red pickup truck... still speeding down city streets.

The driver, 26-year-old Cameron Lamb, was chasing his ex-girlfriend in a stolen truck - weaving across lanes and running through stoplights.

My husband and his partner responded to the call and caught up with the suspect as he attempted to back the stolen truck into a garage.

Both detectives got out of their police vehicles and approached the stolen truck while repeatedly ordering the suspect to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS.

That's when it happened.

**As Eric 's partner approached the driver's side, the suspect reached into his waistband and pulled out a handgun - pointing it directly at the detective.**

**My husband 's police training kicked in.**

He fired four rounds in the direction of the suspect through the truck's front windshield. The truck continued traveling into the garage where it finally came to a stop.

When officers entered, they found the suspect deceased - his arm hanging out the open window with a .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground below.

That night, when Eric returned home, I hugged him and burst into tears. I was so thankful he was safe - and hopeful we could move forward and put this episode behind us.

But it didn't end there.

Several months later, the local prosecutor _charged Eric with MANSLAUGHTER and Armed Criminal Action._

I was in shock.

Then late last year, my husband finally went to trial. The judge ruled against him - and Eric was sentenced to 6 years in prison.

Now you understand why I'm asking for your help.

My husband is an honest man of integrity who followed in his father's law enforcement footsteps. Eric himself is a decorated, 21-year veteran of the Kansas City Police Department.

He's a role model in our community - a Little League baseball coach, a tireless volunteer, and a loving husband and father.

My husband is a hero.

But it didn't matter to the prosecutor that the suspect recklessly swerved a stolen truck through city streets... that he was violent toward his ex-girlfriend and endangered the lives of her two children... that he pointed a stolen gun directly at a police officer.

For serving our community for over 20 years - and risking his life - my has been shipped to an out-of-state prison.

And since the Missouri Supreme Court recently declined to take up Eric's case, that's where he'll stay for the next six years unless he receives a pardon from the Governor of Missouri. He'll miss our wedding anniversaries, our children's birthdays, their graduations(?), and our home will be left without the father and husband we love.

Even if Eric's good name is eventually cleared, just thinking about the cost of his defense and now our efforts to get him pardoned is overwhelming...

... but thank God we got a call from Jason Johnson, President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF).

If you've ever heard of LELDF you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly accused police officers like Eric.

LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments.

And with the thought of trying to suddenly raise our three children alone - I was certainly at one of the lowest moments of my life.

Not only did the LELDF board decide to help provide Eric with the best possible legal defense, but now they're helping us launch a nationwide petition campaign urging Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon Eric.

But as a non-profit organization, they depend solely on generous gifts from folks like you to defend officers like Eric.

I truly believe God is using Jason and the LELDF to answer our prayers.

That's because my husband and I are not wealthy people. I'm a kindergarten teacher and Eric is a career cop.

So I must ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone.

**Will you donate[$35 or any amount to LELDF today to help save my husband?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv4a1q64umkj760t7rudj7pb70o0gcdetfv8vmhg_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9ieao74c5h2bs)**

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I am so scared for Eric and I will do whatever I can for him - and for our children.

**[So I pray you'll find it in your heart today to make a tax-deductible gift of $35, $50, $100 or more to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zenrr8d385v7t09qijaohd3s6v2pbqj66029s2e8_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9ieao74c5h2bs)**

Eric and I - and our three kids - are counting on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you to help bring Eric home where he belongs.

No matter what you're able to give today, please pray for us. Thank you in advance for your support.

Sincerely,

Sarah DeValkenaere

P.S. The Missouri Supreme Court has declined to take Eric's case. Now a pardon is one of the last remaining options to bring Eric home. We're feverishly trying to raise the money to pay for a massive petition drive urging the Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon Eric. I know my husband is innocent. But it's so hard to be a cop these days. The 'defund the police' movement has wiped out the support officers like Eric need to do their jobs.

And dozens of prosecutors across the country have made it a priority to try and lock up as many cops as they can. Even if they followed their training or defended themselves in the line of duty. The brave men and women in blue need to know that someone... anyone still has their back.

**[That's why I sincerely hope you'll help me get justice for Eric - and our entire family - by making a tax-deductible gift of any amount to the LELDF today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqjtahck9rq4fei9s9l99enbjli0hcvk93frc4og_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9ieao74c5h2bs)**

Thank you, and God bless!
--------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember -Blue Lives Matter!_

body:
| | | |
---

**Campaign Updates for April 14, 2024**
Flemming Larsen met with voters, attended fundraisers, and canvassed voters' houses this week. He was also endorsed by Nevada's Lt. Governor! Read on to learn about Flemming's next townhall.
|
---
**Lt. Governor Anthony Stavros Endorses Flemming Larsen**

| On Monday, April 7 Nevada's Lt. Governor Stavros Anthony endorsed Flemming Larsen for Congress: "Thrilled to share that Lt. Gov Stavros Anthony has officially endorsed my candidacy for Nevada's First Congressional District," said Flemming. "This endorsement is more than just a support statement; it's a united front for a brighter, safer, and prosperous Nevada. With a focus on core issues like border security, tackling inflation, advocating for school choice, and uplifting our veterans, we're committed to making a real difference. Grateful for this significant mark of trust and unity, and I'm inspired to push harder for the values we hold dear. Together, we can achieve a future where our communities thrive, our economy booms and everyone gets a fair chance at the American dream. Let's make it happen!"
---

|
---
**Flemming 's "Coffee with Candidates" Tour Continues**

There are still opportunites to dive into meaningful conversations with Flemming and other passionate elected leaders and candidates over a cup of coffee. This is your chance to connect, ask questions, and truly engage with those shaping our state and country.
|
---
**Support Flemming at the "Meet the Candidates" Townhall**

On April 16th, Flemming will speak at the "Meet the Candidates Townhall". Come ask Flemming questions, share your concerns, and learn how to get involved.
|
---
**Flemming Meets With Voters in Nevada**

On Sunday, Flemming met with voters in Nevada: "Sunday Funday on the campaign trail," said Flemming. "Feeling incredibly blessed to have met so many wonderful voters in my congressional district today. Your stories, enthusiasm, and support inspire me every day. Together, we can make a difference."
|
---
**Election Day is 61 Days Away!**

This week, Flemming attended coffees, luncheons, meet and greets, and doorknocked: "It's been a whirlwind of activity on the campaign trail the last couple of days, meeting so many of you at coffees, luncheons, door knocking, and meet and greets," said Flemming. "Your enthusiasm fuels my drive to represent you in DC. Together, let's make our voices heard, Election Day is only 61 days away."
|
---
**Flemming 's Campaign Picks Up Momentum**

Last Saturday, Flemming met voters, canvassed, and attended a fundraising dinner: "What a whirlwind day on the campaign trail today! body:
Chicago Cubs co-owner and former Trump RNC Finance Chair Todd Ricketts sends shockwaves through the IL GOP by voicing support for Dr. Eric Wallace.

view in browser (https://mailchi.mp/198b787469f7/exclusive-donald-trump-jr-draws-large-crowds-receives-lifetime-membership-10299572?e=1cb5fdae9e) | update preferences (https://illinoisreview.us14.list-manage.com/profile?u=811d47b3c0783e80274d515f7&id=1a5a561027&e=1cb5fdae9e&c=9c8addcdf8) | unsubscribe (https://illinoisreview.us14.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=811d47b3c0783e80274d515f7&id=1a5a561027&t=b&e=1cb5fdae9e&c=9c8addcdf8)

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to hear about the latest developments sending shock waves through the Illinois Republican Party. Continue to follow Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9c8addcdf8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) for more updates.

** Exclusive: Chicago Cubs Co-Owner, Former Trump RNC Finance Chair Todd Ricketts Endorses Dr. Eric Wallace for Cook County GOP Chairman (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/exclusive-chicago-cubs-co-owner-former-trump-rnc-finance-chair-todd-ricketts-endorses-dr-eric-wallace-for-cook-county-gop-chairman.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9c8addcdf8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/exclusive-chicago-cubs-co-owner-former-trump-rnc-finance-chair-todd-ricketts-endorses-dr-eric-wallace-for-cook-county-gop-chairman.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9c8addcdf8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

By Illinois Review

The Cook County Republican Central Committee Convention this Wednesday is expected to be an energetic one, as Dr. Eric Wallace, founder of the Freedom Journal Institute has announced his intention to challenge incumbent Sean Morrison for Chairman of the Cook County Republican Party.

Morrison has served as chairman since 2016, and currently serves as Cook County Commissioner representing the 17th District. Morrison is also on the state central committee – the governing board of the Illinois Republican Party and remains a close confidante and ally of embattled IL GOP Chairman Don Tracy.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/exclusive-chicago-cubs-co-owner-former-trump-rnc-finance-chair-todd-ricketts-endorses-dr-eric-wallace-for-cook-county-gop-chairman.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9c8addcdf8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

And sources confirm that Chicago Cubs co-owner Todd Ricketts is weighing in and endorsing Wallace for chairman. In 2019, President Donald Trump selected Ricketts to serve as Finance Chairman for Trump Victory. Ricketts was also listed as a co-chair for the Palm Beach fundraiser a few weeks ago that raised a record $50.5 million for President Donald Trump’s presidential campaign. In 2019, President Trump selected Todd to serve as Finance Chairman for Trump Victory.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/exclusive-chicago-cubs-co-owner-former-trump-rnc-finance-chair-todd-ricketts-endorses-dr-eric-wallace-for-cook-county-gop-chairman.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9c8addcdf8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Illinois Republican Party officials have come under fire for their lack of support for the conservative grassroots base of the party – and for their lack of support for President Trump – the presumptive Republican nominee for President of the United States.

Disgraced Chicago Republican Party Chairman
Steve Boulton (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/chicago-gop-chair-steve-boulton-calls-ir-reporting-a-smear-campaign-as-il-gop-leaders-don-tracy-richard-porter-ignore-his-comments-comparing-trump-to-hitler.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9c8addcdf8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – a close ally and friend of Morisson, is digging in his heels and attacking this publication for reporting that in 2016, he compared Donald Trump to Adolf Hitler – calling the revelations a “smear campaign” as party officials, including state party chairman Don Tracy and Morrison, remain silent – failing to call out Boulton for his despicable comment.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/exclusive-chicago-cubs-co-owner-former-trump-rnc-finance-chair-todd-ricketts-endorses-dr-eric-wallace-for-cook-county-gop-chairman.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9c8addcdf8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Wallace is widely respected amongst conservatives, and if elected, he’d be the first African American to serve as Chairman of the Cook County Republican Party. Dr. Wallace holds post-graduate degrees in Biblical Studies (https://freedomsjournalinstitute.org/eric-m-wallace-bio?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9c8addcdf8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) . A former pastor, Wallace is known as a dynamic speaker and writer and he’s traveled the country talking about faith and public policy. In 2011, Wallace and his wife, Jennifer, founded Freedom’s Journal Institute (FJI) for the Study of Faith and Public Policy, an Illinois-based nonprofit organization designed to “advance the Kingdom of God through socio-political, education and engagement.”

In addition to earning Ricketts’ support, Wallace is also endorsed by former Republican candidate for governor Max Solomon, 18th Ward Committeeman and Chairman of the Southside GOP Devin Jones, New Trier Township Committeeman Julie Cho and Elk Grove Township Republican Chairman and Committeeman Ed Lapinski.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/exclusive-chicago-cubs-co-owner-former-trump-rnc-finance-chair-todd-ricketts-endorses-dr-eric-wallace-for-cook-county-gop-chairman.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9c8addcdf8-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

---

| BARGERSVILLE TOWN COUNCIL PRESIDENT JAMES RUMELL ENDORSES BUSINESS LEADER JAMISON CARRIER FOR CONGRESS
---
| Greenwood, IN \- Today, Jamison Carrier, a businessman from Greenwood, announced that Bargersville Town Council President James Rumell II has endorsed his campaign to replace Congressman Greg Pence, who is retiring at the end of his term in 2024.
James Rumell II Statement: "I'm honored to endorse Jamison Carrier for Congress to replace Rep. Greg Pence, who is retiring at the end of the year. I know he is ready to fight for our conservative values in Washington and work hard for all of the constituents here in the Sixth District. Jamison is a man of faith, cares about his family, and has the right business mind to get our country on track in these times of uncertainty. We need Jamison Carrier in Washington."

A one-on-one matchup with Adam Schiff on November 5th. **[**Can I count on your contribution of $6 to help defeat Adam Schiff today?**](https://links.greatamericatoday.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=df74939c22104ab5b645f860b42b036b&_e=i0mc4vgSFhD_t90ab2sUhRePcca5we8MpEkPwdrBDkB49U2q8nZhe957fDwCu_0LXjXPjMRbvLC6wr2BfPOCkbbbcMbhAI6feI6fZr5uulmPZhkasialZvfQUvEXSB5hHs5YeeqAQFv6AKq5m5U13EHGOw1vGF7dhdRt6lkviHrWdYj7Sn7O8hwEyTFQDXNA_LvWy1Ax-7hoXfjVLcngz72Tl0CszYMcfz3SiRHqlLTqX-cYvJPFc_7kpOSQ9k9bF7MmRHYxD8w3Sjbw5RiKiERj2JlKaNeRnAL7Vl6C5JVhl_ZNdPbzotczFFfq45FpJZ5aAiuB0-enXYk5ILBUsUxCJKnWzxaBGnC_3E2zZZBD9NrNMQXT2ms-msEqzr4Ju_xR7zYgHrsVBpLg4avz3w%3D%3D)** You see, Adam Schiff's enablers in the corporate media are already spreading the lie that this race is over. They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they'd rather face me: **_Be careful what you wish for._** I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. **[That said, I must ask: will you rush a contribution to my senate campaign today?](https://links.greatamericatoday.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=df74939c22104ab5b645f860b42b036b&_e=i0mc4vgSFhD_t90ab2sUhRePcca5we8MpEkPwdrBDkB49U2q8nZhe957fDwCu_0LXjXPjMRbvLC6wr2BfPOCkbbbcMbhAI6feI6fZr5uulmPZhkasialZvfQUvEXSB5hHs5YeeqAQFv6AKq5m5U13EHGOw1vGF7dhdRt6lkviHrWdYj7Sn7O8hwEyTFQDXNA_LvWy1Ax-7hoXfjVLcngz72Tl0CszYMcfz3SiRHqlLQskEh9Bs68R03h20U4nED_ByW8UiCItxko-mKG_8oq8qwxrDkQZcpOE16SrgBCthe3TKWxzPpZM4yNCHI7c7wIAUvjSjdTOs8wFd-WxiDfce-1FHzM4S9tD9UWrmEfUu-qlKursMGnWvjafMoH9UnzN4ZfZEXTxTWVrD8T_re4XQ%3D%3D) ** This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you!

| Recently, parents in Dallas County received a link to a survey developed by the county health department entitled “Vaccine Hesitancy”. After collecting demographic information about the parent and child, the survey probes into the parents' personal choices about childhood vaccines, including “Have you ever said no to getting a vaccine for your child?” "If so, why?" Interestingly, it also asks if the parent would be interested in going to a “meeting about vaccines” _in their school district_ and if the parent would participate in “a vaccine clinic” _at their school._ (If you’ve been following TFVC for a while, you’ll recall [**the pitfalls of these in-school clinics**](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNDU5NjA0MTg5Mzc5MDQxMzkzJmM9cDZjMCZlPTAmYj0xMzA4NzEzOTg5JmQ9eDZqMWYwaQ==.l8UgLIcgkxtuoPTi42Uy1a8h12vJPDQJpR7maNb99BI).) Why is a county department using taxpayer-funded resources to data mine about private healthcare decisions? Furthermore, why are they floating the idea of addressing “vaccine hesitancy” through meetings and clinics at their child’s school, another taxpayer-funded entity? **If you’ve received such a survey from a government agency in your area, let us know!**

| | Peter, A wise woman once said, “when a clown moves into a palace, it doesn’t make him a king. The palace just becomes a circus.” **Unfortunately, that seems like the mantra of the current House GOP, where every day Congress feels like it’s under the big top.** They think the American people will think they are solving real problems when the truth of the matter is they’re actually just making them up, while mixing in infighting for good measure. But with the issues facing IL-17 and the country, now isn’t the time for show, it’s the time for go. Winning the Democratic majority means we can:
* Codify _Roe v Wade_ into national law.
* Pass critical democratic reforms like the John Lewis Voting Rights Act.
* Ensure thousands of new jobs come to our district.
* _And so much more._

And with Mike Johnson’s super PAC once again naming me as a top target in 2024, we know the path to the real, _actual_ solutions we deserve will come down to holding IL-17. body:
Kevin Dellicker is the best candidate to defeat Susan Wild |
---
| | [ ](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=580605a16f&e=1090c5c412)

|
---
| Dear Friends and Neighbors,

With one week to go until the Primary Election, the Dellicker team is energized and confident about our prospects. We’re leading in fundraising. We’re leading in endorsements. And we have the best volunteers in Pennsylvania.

Thanks to everyone who plays a role in this campaign. My wife Susan and I are truly grateful. You are helping to Keep America Free.

I’m running for Congress because we are losing our way of life to progressives and career politicians. And I love my country and community too much to let that happen.

Progressives weaken our military, open our borders, and demonize our police. They harm working families and senior citizens with high inflation and interest rates. And they damage our families by attacking our hometown values.

Career politicians get elected to office and never leave. They vote to stay in power and not to serve the people. And they lie and defame others to acquire power with no thought of the damage they inflict on our political process.

I’m a commonsense conservative, and I’m certainly no career politician. I’m a veteran, a business owner, and a family man. I’ll go to Washington, get the job done, and then come home, just like our Founders intended.

I’m the best candidate to defeat Susan Wild because I’m the only Republican with real-world experience in the most important issues affecting our nation. I know how to ensure safe communities, create good jobs, and raise strong families. And I have the track record to prove it.

Real-world experience doesn’t just matter to Republican voters. It matters to all voters. Nobody wants more career politicians telling them what to do.

If it’s God’s will, I’ll win this primary, defeat Susan Wild, and enact conservative policies that turn our country around.

Please make sure you vote by mail or in person this primary season. I would be honored to earn your vote.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a Republican from Heidelberg Township, Lehigh County, running for U.S. House of Representatives in Pa.’s 7th District. He is a 28-year military veteran, technology company owner, husband and father. He’s not a career politician. He’s a proven leader with the experience and courage to Keep America Free. Learn more at[www.dellickerforcongress.com](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=f045ae6a46&e=1090c5c412)._

| **VOLUNTEER FOR THE DELLICKER CAMPAIGN**
Working a poll on election day is one of the most important things you can do to help Kevin win the primary. Poll workers greet voters as they approach, hand out Dellicker campaign literature, and ask them to vote for Kevin. To become a poll worker, please email Linda Swankoski at [swankoskil@hotmail.com](mailto:swankoskil@hotmail.com?subject=Poll%20Worker&body=I%20would%20like%20to%20volunteer%20at%20a%20poll.)

Also, it's not too late to go get your Dellicker for Congress yard signs. Please email Michelle to make arrangements at [michelle@dellickerforcongress.com](mailto:michelle@dellickerforcongress.com?subject=Signs&body=I%20would%20like%20campaign%20signs%20please.).

**We appreciate all your help to win the election and Keep America Free!**

| Last week, I addressed the Lehigh GOP in Allentown and talked to voters in Coopersburg along with Southern Lehigh GOP chairman Doug Durham. Thanks Doug! I visited the Lehighton 9-12 Project in Jim Thorpe and earned the endorsement of this important grassroots organization in Carbon County. I delivered the prayer at the New Tripoli Fire Company volunteer meeting on Saturday before attending the Donald Trump Rally in Schnecksville. It was great to see the former president articulate his plans for a second term. I must have met 1,000 people that day. Finally, I spent Monday evening in the Slate Belt talking about hunting and fishing and the 2nd Amendment. It's only one week until the Primary Election. We will finish strong and are positioned to win.

Peter,
Donald Trump, Fox News, and the far-right are trying to defund NPR for a supposed left-wing bias.
[**We’ll discuss why NPR is suddenly under attack in a second, but if you already know you support COURIER’s mission to stop right-wing conspiracy theories like those about NPR, can you contribute $10 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83138300/467418068/-593472309?refcode=20240416-EM-NPR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjRjYjc3YzktMTJmYy1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=sHZRZoX0xViNl8y0uN2G8YECTIRw-aK4FUxxc3xrdBM=)
So why is the right going after NPR, and why now?
Last week, an NPR business editor penned an op-ed expressing concern that NPR now has fewer Republican listeners than it did a decade ago.
The editor failed to cite Trump's rise and the far-right politics behind the trend. Instead, he blamed a few cherry-picked NPR editorial decisions for the Republican decline.
**Despite his critical views, he made it clear in his piece that defunding NPR wasn’t the solution.**
Regardless, Trump and his cronies used the very flawed but good-faith critique in a full-on campaign to smear NPR as a “liberal disinformation machine” and a “total scam.”
Now, they’re calling on Congress to defund the organization.
Of course, we’ve seen this before. Right-wing conspiracy theories always take on a familiar pattern:
* Spread a lie (here that NPR is a “disinformation machine”)
* Watch that lie spread like wildfire through right-wing leaders, Fox News, and social media influencers, including QAnon and other far-right groups
* Once enough people believe the lie, attack your enemy as if the lie were true

At COURIER, we believe everyone deserves access to free, honest news. Publicly funded news services like NPR are vital to local communities.
**When right-wing bad actors spread dangerous conspiracy theories about NPR, they are attacking our democracy.**
At COURIER, our mission is to correct the record when right-wing bad actors attack. In addition, our ten newsrooms are on the ground in battleground states nationwide. Every day, they cover the local issues that matter in the communities we serve. The best part is that we make our coverage freely available to anyone who needs it in the social media feeds and inboxes where people actually get their news.

body:
Hey Peter,

There’s so much going on with Leaders We Deserve lately that it’s even
hard for me to keep track of. So I figured I’d take a couple minutes to
update you all on what we’ve been up to lately — because we’ve definitely
been busy.

This email might get a little long, so if you just want to pitch in to
help us make up the gap from missing our mid-month goal and elect more
young leaders this November, you can do that here:
[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwed-em-20240416-1?refcode=em20240416-1-569&refcode2=569_587540_QnzwNG&akid=569%2E587540%2EQnzwNG ]https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwed-em-20240416-1

I know we’ve been talking about it forever, but we finally just endorsed
our first slate of 6 candidates for the 2024 cycle: Sarah McBride,
Christine Cockley, Bryce Berry, Ashwin Ramaswami, Anna Thomas, and Anja
Wookey-Huffman.

But we’re not stopping there. There are a ton of up-and-coming young
leaders who we’re going to elect this year, and we’ll be releasing our
next round of endorsements very soon — stay tuned for that!

Once we’ve endorsed a candidate, we’re going all in to help get them
elected. We help with everything from candidate training to messaging to
organizing and GOTV, and in many state legislative races, our work makes a
huge difference.

We’ve also been working on hiring our own staff to help execute on our
plans, and we just got a new office, too. It’ll give us all a place to
work and meet with folks in DC, which will be super important as the
election gets closer.

Peter, I wasn’t
lying when I said we’ve been up to a lot. But the truth is none of this
would be possible without your grassroots support. Leaders We Deserve
doesn’t take corporate donations. We rely on you to support our mission.

So if you can, will you pitch in $3 or any amount that
works for you to help us fill in the gaps of our April mid-month goal?
Here’s a secure link you can use:
[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwed-em-20240416-1?refcode=em20240416-1-569&refcode2=569_587540_QnzwNG&akid=569%2E587540%2EQnzwNG ]https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwed-em-20240416-1

With Election Day getting closer and our work ramping up, your support is
critical. And I can’t thank you enough for pitching in.

Thanks, Peter.
More updates soon.

David Hogg

clean_body: News from the League | April 16, 2024 | Redwoods on film California’s big trees take center stage in Giants Rising —a feature-length documentary that explores the mysteries of the redwood forests through the prism of science, art, and Indigenous wisdom. Join director Lisa Landers and League president Sam Hodder at the DocLands Film Festival premiere on May 4. Ancestral land Big news: The League and partners have signed a landmark agreement that would return land in Humboldt County to the Yurok Tribe. Learn more about the vision to build a new visitor gateway to Redwood National and State Parks and create a groundbreaking model for Indigenous land management. Connection A mother shares how her 13-year-old son found solace and peace among the giant sequoias of Sequoia & Kings Canyon National Parks: “Nature spoke to him in a language of its own, offering a sense of wonder and connection that transcended the barriers of autism.” State park expansion The addition of 80-acre Rocky Ridge brings 360-degree views, peregrine falcon habitat, and even more old-growth redwoods to Montgomery Woods in Mendocino County. Join us in celebrating the first transfer of League-conserved land to California State Parks in over a decade. Earth Day Join more than 1 billion people around the globe in protecting our natural wonders—including California’s amazing, carbon-storing redwood forests. Discover outdoor activities, community celebrations, and ways to take positive action. | | Instagram Post of the Month ---|--- | | ---|--- Every great party needs a DANCE CAPTAIN! 🕺Join internet sensation Griff Griffith @TheNatureNut as he electrifies the dance floor at 🌲Take Me to the Trees,🌲 the League’s annual redwoods celebration on May 18. Grab your friends and head to SF’s historic Presidio for amazing food & cocktails, redwoods fun, and the glittery sounds of 💎Super Diamond💎 🎟️Tickets at 🔗 THE LEAGUE IN THE NEWS Associated Press SF Gate Indian Country Today Support our work Connect with us | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- | | Save the Redwoods League 111 Sutter Street, 11th Floor San Francisco, CA 94104 United States |

body: Background on hush money trial of former President Donald Trump [NEWSLINK] BREAKING NEWS... body:
I won’t ever forget it, friend.
Standing on the House floor. Hearing shouts, pounding, breaking glass. Barricading the door, teaching my colleagues how to use their gas masks. Texting my staff, telling them to hide.
I carried a rifle in Iraq and all I had to defend myself on January 6th was a pen. But I was ready to fight.
And after that day, Trump’s loyalists crawled right back to him. Witnessing them reject what they lived through, watching them ignore the testimony of the police officers that defended us that day while they were beaten, bloodied, pepper sprayed, cursed at... it makes me sick.
Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots who were “invited in” — she even campaigns with them.
I think anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.
This race in Arizona is just me and her. It’s on us to stop her march to more power and influence. Whoever wins in Arizona is going to determine which party holds the Senate, and could even decide whether Trump takes back the White House.
I need you with me, and I need you to take this race seriously.
Please split a donation of $25 — that or anything you can give — between my campaign and Serve America to crush Kari Lake’s campaign and defend our democracy. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-gallego]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-gallego]
Thanks for your support. As we gear up for one of the toughest elections of our lives, it means a lot to have you behind me.
Ruben

Texting my staff, telling them to hide. I carried a rifle in Iraq and all I had to defend myself on January 6th was a pen. But I was ready to fight. And after that day, Trump’s loyalists crawled right back to him. Witnessing them reject what they lived through, watching them ignore the testimony of the police officers that defended us that day while they were beaten, bloodied, pepper sprayed, cursed at... it makes me sick. Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots who were “invited in” — she even campaigns with them. I think anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate. This race in Arizona is just me and her. It’s on us to stop her march to more power and influence. Whoever wins in Arizona is going to determine which party holds the Senate, and could even decide whether Trump takes back the White House. I need you with me, and I need you to take this race seriously. Please split a donation of $25 — that or anything you can give — between my campaign and Serve America to crush Kari Lake’s campaign and defend our democracy. [] DONATE [] Thanks for your support. As we gear up for one of the toughest elections of our lives, it means a lot to have you behind me. Team,
It is no secret that Republicans are not slowing down on book bans. ** ICYMI: Top stories from the past week!
------------------------------------------------------------

** "Crouch leads the pack in money on hand for final governor's race push"
------------------------------------------------------------

As the six Republican candidates round the final bend before the May 7 primary in the 2024 governor’s race, Lt. Gov. Suzanne Crouch leads the pack in terms of money on hand, according to the new campaign finance reports filed Monday.

Combined, the candidates have nearly $5 million left to spend and have spent a jaw-dropping $20 million in the first quarter of 2024. In 2023, the six potential nominees spent nearly $14.5 million, almost certainly making this race the most expensive gubernatorial nomination in Indiana history with another few weeks to go.

Every one of you who took the time to share your advice, insights, experience, and even great memories from the campaign trail (you know who you are!) are so appreciated by us. Our team’s grassroots connection is special, and your feedback here was a great reminder of that. We’ve read through your responses (Tom has them all printed out on his desk), and found out pretty quickly that there were common “themes”... **_“Focus on the issues” - Chris P._** **_“Have a plan for making life more affordable. That’s why I love Tom Kean, Jr. He’s a man of his word that will actually do what he says he’ll do, lead with real integrity, and will reach across the aisle. That’s how it should be. Thanks Tom!” - Paula S._** **_“Nothing better than some good old-fashioned face-to-face conversations in my opinion (and personal experience)! I think meeting and shaking hands with as many of your constituents as possible would be a wonderful thing.” - Jill W._** _And last, but certainly not least..._ 🔥 **_“Don’t get CRAZY! Both Democrats AND Republicans can be SO EXTREME these days it makes my head hurt. Let’s all just take a deep breath and find some common ground on the things that truly matter most.” - Lucille P._** Across the board, this is some TERRIFIC feedback, Team! **We couldn’t agree more and please know this—**** _Tom is taking every single word of your feedback to heart._** Now, let’s roll up our sleeves and get to work on charting our path to victory.
