clean_body: There’s a common theme here. | | | | | Wow, friend... We reached out last week, asking for tips on how you think we as Republicans can win this November and oh boy did you all D-E-L-I-V-E-R! Seriously—thank you! Every one of you who took the time to share your advice, insights, experience, and even great memories from the campaign trail (you know who you are!) are so appreciated by us. Our team’s grassroots connection is special, and your feedback here was a great reminder of that. We’ve read through your responses (Tom has them all printed out on his desk), and found out pretty quickly that there were common “themes”... “Focus on the issues” - Chris P. “Have a plan for making life more affordable. EVERYTHING has gone up and my family can’t keep up in Biden’s economy.” - Madelyn H. “We’ve got to secure our border and protect American families from the violence, drugs, trafficking, etc that is pouring into our communities as a result of the current administration's catastrophic border policies (or lack thereof).” - Joe M. “Character still counts!! That’s why I love Tom Kean, Jr. He’s a man of his word that will actually do what he says he’ll do, lead with real integrity, and will reach across the aisle. That’s how it should be. Thanks Tom!” - Paula S. “Nothing better than some good old-fashioned face-to-face conversations in my opinion (and personal experience)! I think meeting and shaking hands with as many of your constituents as possible would be a wonderful thing.” - Jill W. And last, but certainly not least... 🔥 “Don’t get CRAZY! Both Democrats AND Republicans can be SO EXTREME these days it makes my head hurt. Let’s all just take a deep breath and find some common ground on the things that truly matter most.” - Lucille P. Across the board, this is some TERRIFIC feedback, Team! We couldn’t agree more and please know this— Tom is taking every single word of your feedback to heart. Now, let’s roll up our sleeves and get to work on charting our path to victory. | | | | To victory, Team Kean | | | In one of the most competitive races in America last cycle, TOM KEAN JR. flipped New Jersey's 7th District which led to flipping the House from Radical Democrat Rule. Friend, Earlier this year, at the start of the legislative session, Governor Wes Moore and Lieutenant Governor Aruna Miller outlined four priorities for the session to make Maryland safer, more affordable, more competitive, and the state that serves. We’re proud to share that through a partnership with our state legislators and other critical stakeholders, we’ve made _**significant**_ progress on all four of the Governor’s priorities. We’ve shown just how much we can accomplish **together.** Putting the political games aside, we've shown how a state government is supposed to work. The Governor’s agenda makes record investments in education and public safety, child care, and housing — all without raising personal income tax, corporate income tax, or sales tax. Moving in partnership, Governor Moore passed legislation that created Maryland’s first-ever gun violence prevention center, legislation to put more sworn officers on the streets to make our communities safer, and he put forward the most comprehensive housing package the state has ever seen. And, as tragedy struck with the collapse of the Francis Scott Key Bridge, he didn’t miss a beat and stepped into action immediately by putting forward Executive Orders, supporting the PORT Act with the state legislature, and continuing to work with our federal partners to secure much-needed funding for the recovery. The Moore-Miller administration is making the investments we need to protect our future and the working families of Maryland. Thank you for riding along this journey with us — we cannot do this work without you. Team Moore

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: A note about Sudan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
This week we recognize the one-year mark of a brutal and cruel war in Sudan, and I wanted to share a few thoughts with you.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240416-3757-footer&t=1&akid=3757%2E420207%2ELYktBO)
Peter,
This week we recognize the one-year mark of a brutal and cruel war in Sudan, and I wanted to share a few thoughts with you.
In 2020, I visited Sudan as part of a Congressional delegation to meet with the new President after the Sudanese people inspired the entire world when they rose up and demanded an end to the dictatorship of President Omar al Bashir and a transition to democracy.
I met many of the leaders of the peaceful nonviolent movement, and seeing their courage and resilience continued to give me hope._It breaks my heart to see the country plunged back into chaos and widespread suffering._
Too many of the Sudanese people have been displaced from their homes, and face not only the violence and cruelty of war, but also critical shortages of food, water, medicine, and electricity.
For decades, brutal military dictatorships have denied the Sudanese people their basic human rights. And since the start of the current conflict between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) **more than 12,000 people have been killed, 6 million have been internally displaced, and 1.5 million have fled the country as refugees.**
Human rights groups have documented extremely high rates of sexual violence against women and girls in the region. Estimates also forecast that as many as 250,000 children and pregnant women could die of malnutrition in the coming months and only 30 percent of hospitals in Sudan are functioning.
I have been in close touch with the U.S. Special Envoy for Sudan and urged the White House to utilize every tool in its toolbox — including sanctions for those involved in furthering this violence — to push for successful peace talks that implement the Sudanese people’s vision of civilian democracy and towards funding immediate humanitarian assistance from all our global partners.
**We cannot turn a blind eye to the loss of life and suffering of the Sudanese people and their clear desire for a constitutional transition.** I hope all of us can become engaged in protecting innocent Sudanese civilians and work hard to ensure that all Americans understand the human consequences of what is happening in Sudan.
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

Hey there — I wanted to take a moment to reach out to you personally this morning. This time last week, we’d just gotten word that the Arizona Supreme Court upheld a 160-year-old, near-total ban on abortion, putting the lives of MILLIONS of Arizonans at stake. When the news dropped last Tuesday, we had to mount a response quickly, and if we didn’t already have a large base of monthly contributions to lean on, **we would’ve easily fallen short and wouldn’t be where we are right now.** Over the last week, this strong grassroots team made it possible for us to meet this moment with the urgency it deserved. This team took off, generating headlines and activating volunteers from Flagstaff to Mesa, and even capped off our week with a visit from Vice President Kamala Harris in Tucson. | | _“Arizonans are ready to vote out the archaic 1864 ban pushed by Donald Trump and Arizona Republicans, and to re-elect President Biden and Vice President Harris,” said Arizona Democratic Party Chairwoman Yolanda Bejarano. “As Republicans scramble to lie about their records, the Biden-Harris administration is doing everything in their power to fight back against this attack on our freedom. Voters will remember that Vice President Harris has repeatedly shown up for us– supporting local leaders, mobilizing voters across the state, and calling out Republicans extremism in the face of this horrific ban.” _ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83151557/467457195/-1974965524?recurring=true&refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240416_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmQ5NDg2NmMtMjlmYy1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0WZaLvqKaeomL3j1GK5uuwiLCnsx7Iwie-2jV7Y3bY8=)

**[So here’s what I’m asking today: Will you consider joining our base of recurring donors by starting a monthly grassroots gift?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83151558/467457196/-1974965524?recurring=true&refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240416_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmQ5NDg2NmMtMjlmYy1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0WZaLvqKaeomL3j1GK5uuwiLCnsx7Iwie-2jV7Y3bY8=)**

I’m endlessly grateful we have such a strong team that has what it takes to help us overcome every challenge. Thanks for stepping up.

Dear Friend,
As we embark on our mission to create positive change in Michigan’s 4th District, we're reaching out to you with an opportunity to make a real difference.
Our campaign is driven by a vision of a West Michigan where every resident has access to quality healthcare, education, and economic opportunity. But to turn this vision into reality, we need your support.
We are thrilled and humbled to announce our recent recognition on the "Marquis Who's Who in America" list. This honor is a testament to years of hard work, dedication, and a commitment to serving our community. Coming from humble beginnings, we've faced challenges head-on and persevered, never losing sight of our goal to make a positive impact. We are deeply grateful for this recognition and will continue to strive for excellence as we work towards a brighter future for all.
[SHOW YOUR SUPPORT](https://alfonsoforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bb75364011dcc8a637f1fdd6f&id=cb8400bb47&e=16d812e81c)

**Your contribution to our campaign will:**
**1\. Empower Our Message:** Your donation will help us amplify our message and reach more voters across West Michigan.
**2\. Mobilize Our Supporters:** With your support, we can mobilize volunteers, organize events, and build a strong grassroots movement for change.
**3\. Invest in Our Community:** Your contribution will enable us to invest in programs and initiatives that address our community's most pressing issues.
Every dollar you donate brings us closer to our goal of creating a brighter future for West Michigan. Together, we can make a meaningful difference in the lives of our fellow residents.
Please consider contributing to our campaign today. Your support is crucial to our success, and we're grateful for your commitment to our cause.
Thank you for standing with us as we work to shape the future of West Michigan.
Team Alfonso

Running on a platform of government accountability and fiscal conservatism, Robert Burns announces his entrance into the race for Executive Council

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/burnsfornh/burns-enters-race-for-executive-council-district-4?e=662ba75570)

Dear Friends,

I am excited to announce my candidacy for the Executive Council, to succeed the retiring Ted Gatsas in District 4! I will fully vet every judicial nominee and ensure that they will strictly interpret the US and state Constitutions. I will review every contract and lease that comes before the Executive Council to ensure that the taxpayers are getting the best deal for quality services. Fresh voices are needed in state government and I will recommend that appointees are outside of the usual insider cliques. I will serve as an advocate and champion of the taxpayers in New Hampshire. My experience in business and my lifelong devotion to helping our state will guide me in this important job. To learn more and sign up to help the campaign, please visit BurnsForNH.com (https://www.burnsfornh.com?utm_source=Burns+for+Congress&utm_campaign=82c9aeec6f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_16_07_04&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-82c9aeec6f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) !

https://www.burns4nh.com?utm_source=Burns+for+Congress&utm_campaign=82c9aeec6f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_16_07_04&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-82c9aeec6f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Robert Burns is a small businessman and lifelong resident of New Hampshire. Burns was born in Nashua, graduated from Manchester West High School, and is a graduate of Keene State College with a degree in Business Management. Currently, Burns owns and operates a growing quality control and safety company in Bedford.

Burns was first elected to serve as a Selectman in Manchester’s Ward 12, where he helped oversee the integrity of the city’s elections. Burns was then elected Hillsborough County Treasurer, defeating then-incumbent Chris Pappas. Burns won the Republican nomination for Executive Council in District 4 in 2012, and 2014

In 2015, he joined Donald Trump’s campaign for President, serving as the National Youth Coalition Chairman and was a Delegate for Trump at the 2016 Republican National Convention. Over the last two decades Burns has worked on a number of campaigns, including for the Presidential races of Mike Huckabee and Newt Gingrich.

Burns won the Republican nomination for New Hampshire’s Second Congressional District in 2022.

Friend,
I'm sure you've heard—we're officially in a rematch for Texas' closest congressional district election.
My life has been about putting in hard, honest work for South Texas—from getting my GED, to community college, to taking on big corporations as an attorney on behalf of working families, and now pushing for bipartisan solutions in Congress.

For my opponent, she spends her days spreading conspiracy theories about the 2020 election, promoting cuts to Social Security and Medicare, and working to restrict access to basic healthcare for our communities.

The difference between us is clear, and that's why it's critical we raise the support to spread our message of progress. Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.

While in law school, Vicente learned how government should work. Through his experience as a Congressional Intern in Washington, D.C., Vicente learned how government really works. After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law.
Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.
Today, Vicente Gonzalez is fighting for our South Texas values in Congress as a member of the Committees on Financial Services and Foreign Affairs and the Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth. Vicente has stood by our promise to veterans, helping constituents cut through red tape at the VA and working across the aisle to prevent the shameful deportation of our honorably discharged veterans. He’s working to lower prescription drug prices, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and ensure that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work.

# Host Committee Happenings
A Newsletter by the Chicago 2024 Host Committee
|
---
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
## Note from the Host Committee
Welcome back to Host Committee Happenings!
Last week, we celebrated the one year anniversary of Chicago being selected to host the Democratic National Convention! Now, we are only 124 days away from the big week! Keep reading for more on our planning efforts to host the most sustainable, inclusive and accessible convention in history.
|
---
## Security Personnel Virtual Outreach Summit
| | | | | | | | | The Chicago 2024 Host Committee and Democratic National Convention Committee hosted a successful virtual outreach summit for security professionals last Thursday. If you missed the session, a replay is available [here](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=72aec86208&e=e789b9d47e).
---
| [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=08aa4f1911&e=e789b9d47e)
---
The team discussed upcoming bid opportunities and requirements for security personnel services at convention venues. Scopes discussed included perimeter control, access management at entry points, credential screening, and security drivers.
|
---
## Subcontracting Opportunities
The latest subcontracting opportunities from our partners are available here: [https://chicago2024.com/rfp/](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=da936dbe49&e=e789b9d47e)
|
---
## Democratic National Convention Announces Sustainability Advisors
| | | | | | | | | The DNCC and the Chicago 2024 Host Committee announced the selection of two women-owned, Chicago-based firms, Bright Beat and Purpose, as Sustainability Advisors for the Democratic National Convention.
---
|
---
[Read WBEZ's story](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=0b9ca9ff19&e=e789b9d47e)
|
---
|
---
## DNC Vendor Directory and Venue Map
| | | | | | | | | Don't miss out on the opportunity to connect with potential customers by including your business in the [Vendor Directory](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=1c20c6bb1f&e=e789b9d47e) and [Venue Map](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=e84ec78386&e=e789b9d47e). Fill out the [Vendor Interest Form](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=9b1a125651&e=e789b9d47e) today!
We appreciate your patience as we carefully review every submission.
---
| [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=3268ec3ba7&e=e789b9d47e)
---
Please note that inclusion in the vendor directory and venue map does not mean the Host Committee, Democratic National Convention Committee, or Democratic National Convention endorse or approve any of the listed vendors. The Directory is offered as a resource to groups and businesses who may need to procure services, facilities, or supplies for their events in Chicago in connection with the 2024 Democratic National Convention, and to encourage the use of local and diverse vendors for those needs.
For questions about vendors, please email [vendors@chicago2024.com](mailto:vendor@chicago2024.com). For questions about venues, please email [venues@chicago2024.com](mailto:venues@chicago2024.com).
|
---
## Volunteer Opportunities
Are you interested in volunteering for the Democratic National Convention this August? We'd love to have you on board. To get started, all you need to do is complete our [Volunteer Interest Form](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=48d4d26c18&e=e789b9d47e).
In case you missed any of our volunteer information sessions, you can always watch a replay [here](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=4e6e6a33ce&e=e789b9d47e).
| | | | | | | | | [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=6b77cd5f3d&e=e789b9d47e)
---
| As we move forward, we'll be inviting individuals who completed the volunteer interest form to fill out a volunteer application. To become an approved volunteer, you will need to complete the volunteer application and background check.
---
If you have any additional questions about volunteering, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at [volunteers@chicago2024.com](mailto:volunteers@chicago2024.com?subject=Question&body=null).
|
---
| | | | | | | | |
## Sponsorship Opportunities
---
Is your business or organization looking for additional ways to get involved with the Democratic National Convention? Consider becoming a Convention sponsor or partner! Inquiries regarding sponsorships and partnerships should be sent to [development@chicago2024.com](mailto:development@chicago2024.com?subject=Sponsorships%20and%20Partnerships&body=null).
|
---
## 77 Spotlight
If you're looking for the perfect blend of city and nature, then **Lincoln Park** is the place for you. Located on the north side of Chicago, the area has a unique mix of busy city life and calm green spaces.
| | | | | | | | |
---
📸 [ _James Andrews_](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=9bb69edafe&e=e789b9d47e)
|
---
📸 [ _JSSIII_](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=09e14919ee&e=e789b9d47e)
|
---
📸 [ _James Andrews_](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=07f2a2eaab&e=e789b9d47e)
| | | | | | | | | Lincoln Park is full of beautiful brick homes, historic churches, and plenty of natural beauty to explore. Take a stroll along the Lakefront Trail or relax on North Avenue Beach. If you're a nature lover, visit the Lincoln Park Conservatory or the Peggy Notebaert Nature Museum. You can also shop at the many boutiques, catch a show at one of the beautiful theaters, or grab a bite at one of the many delicious restaurants.
---
**Check out** the [Alfred Caldwell Lily Pool](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=a8aaa9d8b9&e=e789b9d47e), a National Historic Landmark, for a peaceful escape from the hustle and bustle of city life.
**Explore** [Lincoln Park Zoo](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=59b9b892b3&e=e789b9d47e), the oldest free-admission zoo in the country!
**Eat** at [Boka](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=a4ce5ab0df&e=e789b9d47e), a Michelin-star restaurant, for a fine dining experience that serves seasonal American food.
With so much to see and do, Lincoln Park can keep you busy for a few days.
|
---
📸 [ _Jose Carlos Castro Antelo_](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=cb8b54b624&e=e789b9d47e)
[](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=32a1d10a74&e=e789b9d47e)
📸 [ _Patricia Ybarra_](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=386817c905&e=e789b9d47e)
| | | | | | | | |
---
📸 _Abel Arciniega_[ _@tequilagraphics_](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=32836d0613&e=e789b9d47e)
|
---
📸 [ _urbsinhorto1837_](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=01f2a1cc9f&e=e789b9d47e)
On the south side of the city, you'll find the beautiful **Washington Park**. This predominantly African American neighborhood was established during the great migration and is home to many churches. Don't miss the [DuSable Black History Museum and Education Center](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=c719b4ef21&e=e789b9d47e), the largest African American museum in the country.
**Stroll** through [Washington Park](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=f9ac2b65cc&e=e789b9d47e), which has a lagoon, a harvest garden, and an arboretum.
**Check out** the iconic [Fountain of Time](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=bf8bd38057&e=e789b9d47e), Lorado Taft's masterpiece sculpture.
**Visit** the [Lorraine Hansberry House,](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=1f4b34a353&e=e789b9d47e) a historic Chicago landmark.
**Sip** at [The Park Lounge](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=af8cff63e1&e=e789b9d47e), an elegant space where you can enjoy specialty cocktails and comfort food.
|
---
## Vendor Spotlights
Chicago is home to a wealth of small businesses and vendors. Check out the latest spotlights from our vendor directory:
| | | | | | | | | [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=b929acdfcf&e=e789b9d47e)
---
[Jovie Childcare](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=2fd874ea1b&e=e789b9d47e) is a family-owned and operated childcare service that has been serving families in Chicago for over 17 years. Whether you are staying in a hotel or an Airbnb, or hosting a group event in the city, Jovie can provide on-site childcare services for your little ones.
| [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=91553fd6bd&e=e789b9d47e)
---
[Send Some Chicago](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=8a410fb806&e=e789b9d47e) is a gift box company featuring items from iconic local Chicago companies. With 55+ items to choose from, boxes are curated from brands and local vendors you trust, making for a uniquely Chicago-centric gift box.
_If you’d like to be featured in our newsletter or social media channels, please email us with your business name, logo, description, and a picture or video that best describes your business._
|
---
## Staff Spotlight
Meet **LaWanda A. Neyland** , who works as an Executive Assistant to the Executive Director!
| | | | | | | | | LaWanda is originally from Chicago and currently lives in the **South Shore** neighborhood. As a Chicago native, LaWanda finds it fulfilling to contribute to the development of her hometown. She is excited to be a part of the movement creating a positive impact on the city, its businesses, and its neighborhoods.
LaWanda's favorite restaurant is Steak 48. In her free time, she enjoys reading, cooking and creating new recipes, dancing, working out, spending time with family, hosting game nights, going to concerts and museums, and taking mini-getaway trips.
---
|
---
One of her favorite quotes is, "I strive to be the best that I can be," as it reminds her of the perseverance and determination required to achieve greatness.
|
---
| | | | | | | | |

| | Dear Reader,It's no secret that the vast majority of Americans have lost faith in the press. We've all come to see that many newspapers have abandoned their responsibility to serve the American people. Instead they act, mostly, as the enforcers of the powers and agendas that they favor.

So where do we turn for news we can trust? News that's factual and fair. And where do our leaders turn for the information they need to make world altering decisions. Increasingly there's one answer: The New York Sun.

name: Al Franken
subject: He thinks we’re dumb
disclaimer_text: paid for and provided in kind by End Citizens United Nonfederal, P
body:
| [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/26910?t=1&akid=21274%2E4449941%2EKDt0np)
---
Friend, I like to think I’ve got pretty thick skin, but I’m offended.

[**I’m so fired up that I’m going to ask you right at the top to help kick the jerk who’s pissing me off out of Congress. I’ll explain more below, but will you split a donation between Fight for Reform and Josh Riley’s campaign right now?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/42070?t=7&akid=21274%2E4449941%2EKDt0np)

Marc Molinaro, the MAGA Republican representing NY-19 in Congress, voted TWICE to make Jim Jordan the Speaker of the House. When that didn’t work, he found the one guy even crazier than Jordan to actually give the job to.

And if putting an anti-abortion extremist in charge of the House wasn’t bad enough, when confronted about supporting these nutsos, this is what Molinaro said: _“[Upstate New Yorkers] don’t give a sh*t who the Speaker of the House is... Most of the people I represent wouldn’t know the Speaker of the House if he backed over them with a pickup truck.”_ **_Does he think we’re dumb?_**

[**I, for one, do give a sh*t who’s running our government... and I know you do, too. If you’re as pissed off as I am, I hope you’ll split a contribution between Josh Riley today to fire both Marc Molinaro AND Mike Johnson and Fight for Reform to elect pro-democracy state and local Democrats.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/42070?t=8&akid=21274%2E4449941%2EKDt0np) | [SPLIT A CONTRIBUTION BETWEEN JOSH RILEY AND FIGHT FOR REFORM TODAY »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/42070?t=9&akid=21274%2E4449941%2EKDt0np)
---
It’s clear Molinaro doesn’t think much of the people he represents. But you know who does care a hell of a lot about Upstate New Yorkers? My friend and former Senate counsel, Josh Riley.
[](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/42070?t=10&akid=21274%2E4449941%2EKDt0np)
(I swear I’m not actually this short... Josh is just REALLY tall.)
Josh grew up in a working-class neighborhood in Endicott, NY. When the local factories closed, Josh saw his community struggle – but he worked to put himself through school and graduated from Harvard Law.

In the Senate, Josh and I brought Republicans and Democrats together to actually get stuff done (yes, it really is possible)! The bills we worked on together expanded rights for survivors of domestic abuse and provided new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. It wasn’t easy, but Josh got them signed into law.

Josh DID learn how to drive on a pickup truck, so maybe Molinaro was right about that. **But he’s dead wrong if he thinks we’re too stupid to know or care that he’s voting to screw us over at every turn.**

[ **This is one of the most competitive races in the country, and Josh isn’t going to get to Congress without our help. Please join me by splitting a contribution between Josh and Fight for Reform right now.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/42070?t=11&akid=21274%2E4449941%2EKDt0np)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Josh Riley will go through immediately:

Thanks,

Al

| Dear Peter,

As we observe Black Maternal Health Week, I want to take a moment to talk about this critical issue and why this week is so important to me.

Despite global reductions in maternal mortality rates, preventable deaths related to pregnancy have been rising in the United States over the past two decades.

This rise is driven by far higher mortality rates among Black mothers — who are three to four times more likely to die of pregnancy-related causes.

The impact isn't limited to mothers we’ve lost. Communities of color face a disproportionate burden, with 70 women experiencing "near misses" or lasting health issues for every mother tragically lost. _This is heartbreaking and unacceptable. There's no excuse, we can and must do better._

**That’s why I’m working to pass my Black Maternal Health Momnibus Act — thirteen pieces of legislation that provide the comprehensive resources we need to study and address disparities in access to prenatal care, supportive services, education, and more.**

Look, I don’t expect everyone to contribute each time we send one of these emails. But the truth is we’re a little bit behind on the fundraising targets we need to hit to win this election.

We have to catch up. Fast. But I’m about to say something that would make my finance director’s head spin—**the amount you give doesn’t matter to me.** Here’s why:

I’m proud to run this campaign _the right way_ —with over 500,000 individual contributions from folks like you powering everything we do.

My opponent has the backing of shady billionaires and Mitch McConnell himself. Outside groups are flooding Montana with over **$50,000,000** in TV ads to try and defeat me.

I won’t lie, that’s a lot of cash. And it’s concerning—especially if we don’t have the resources to fight back. But I’d bet on this grassroots team any day of the week.

As Team Kennedy has traveled the country speaking to everyday Americans, it's clear one of the biggest challenges we face is: the skyrocketing price of groceries.
Prices have surged since Biden took office for essentials like milk, eggs, and even toilet paper, significantly affecting family budgets across America.
Butter is up from $3.58 to $4.75
12 Eggs up from $2.36 to $3.54
Milk up from $2.73 to $3.25
Peanut butter up $3.48 to $4.52
Toilet paper up from $7.08 to $9.75
Our leaders have failed to acknowledge and tackle the severe impact of inflation. And President Biden’s team has tried to spin the data to claim that prices are going down!
It is evident that the excessive spending on prolonged military engagements has not only strained our resources but has also failed to enhance our national security. These decisions have serious implications, pushing our economy to the brink and potentially setting the stage for larger conflicts.
President Biden should be telling Americans that their anger is right and justified. He should be acknowledging that everything is so expensive because of the trillions we spent on forever wars. Wars that made us unsafe. Wars that threaten to escalate to catastrophic levels.

Last week, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.

| Peter, I am incredibly disappointed.

Last week, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.

They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.

No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest.

As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.

It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance.

But this is **NOT** over.

If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by Roe v. Wade the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster.

I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign.

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Folding like lawn chairs
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the New Democrat Coalition Action Fund
body:
| We’re on to November against celebrity Republican Steve Garvey, but that’s not all that happened.

Now that Nikki Haley has dropped out of the GOP presidential race, the Republican establishment is once again folding like an assortment of deck chairs — they’re all lining up behind Donald Trump.

Mitch McConnell and virtually every Republican senator are back in Trump’s corner after they refused to hold him accountable for inciting the violent January 6 insurrection that put our lives in danger.

Peltola has yet to condemn Iran as Democrat Party abandons Israel | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/nancyforalaska/ak-al-moves-towards-republicans-after-lt-governor-nancy-dahlstroms-entrance-into-the-race-10299549?e=a20d8ad2ed)
---
[](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=53dc326b0f&e=a20d8ad2ed)
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Contact: [press@nancyforalaska.com](mailto:press@nancyforalaska.com)
**Mary Peltola Remains Silent on Iran’s Attack on Israel** _Peltola has yet to condemn Iran as Democrat Party abandons Israel_
**Anchorage, AK** \- This weekend, Iran launched an attack on Israel in an attempt to destabilize the region and indiscriminately kill civilians. As the most strategic state for our national security, Alaska’s Senators Lisa Murkowski and Dan Sullivan put out clear statements condemning the attack. However, Alaska’s sole Representative to the House [failed](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=5cb2bce0f0&e=a20d8ad2ed) to comment on, nor condemn Iran’s actions.
Congresswoman Mary Peltola’s silence comes as Democrats across the country are facing [pressure](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=7049e66d33&e=a20d8ad2ed) from far-left, pro-Hamas groups. President Joe Biden, who Peltola has endorsed, has also [wavered](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=b0951d2224&e=a20d8ad2ed) in his support of Israel recently and has cautioned the country as they seek to defend themselves against terrorists.
**“I am so disappointed in Representative Peltola, and her lack of leadership on this issue. Her reliance on Democrat talking points and her deafening silence leaves a massive void in our representation,”** stated Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom. **“The United States must stand side-by-side with Israel and we cannot waver in our support. Israel has a right to defend itself from terrorists who want to destroy their country. We need a representative in Congress that has the courage to say just that.”**
Peltola has a history of turning her back on Israel. Earlier this year, she voted against aid for Israel in a funding package. Dahlstrom is the only candidate in the race with true national security experience, contrasted against Peltola who has not been a leading voice on national security issues, which comes at a critical time when both Alaska and the United States face serious threats at home and abroad.
# # #

Team,
In 2021, Michael fought to pass the American Rescue Plan, which increased the size of the Child Tax Credit and made it available to more working families with kids.
The expanded Child Tax Credit was an undeniable success. It cut childhood poverty in the United States nearly in half, and benefitted over 60 million children across the country, including 1 million kids in Colorado.
After six months, Republicans in Congress let this expanded version of the Child Tax Credit expire. Since then, the child poverty rate has more than doubled, and five million children have been forced back into poverty.
Tax Day is a reminder of the work left to do to make our tax code work for everyone, not just those at the very top.
Michael won’t give up on making sure more working families can receive the Child Tax Credit. We can end child poverty and build an economy that works for everyone — and it’s policies like these that will get us there.

body:
I don’t expect you to donate to — or even open — every email from my team and me.
#

Hi,
If you’re anything like me, then I’m sure your inbox is full of messages asking for your support and your contributions.
Trust me, I know how exhausting it can get. And I want you to know that I don’t expect you to donate to — or even open — every email from my team and me.
But since you _did_ open this one, I hope you’ll keep reading and give me a chance to explain the two main reasons I’m asking for your support today.
1. **I want to hold onto our Democratic majority in the Senate.** Democrats are defending double the amount of seats as the GOP, including states that voted for Donald Trump like Ohio and Montana. My goal is to make sure our campaign has the resources to help in any way that these Democratic campaigns ask of us, and I need your support to do so.

2. **I want Democrats to take back the House, and the road to do that runs through California.** Democrats only need to flip a handful of seats to win a majority, and there are enough races in California alone to make it happen. That’s why I’m going to do everything I can to support Democrats up and down the ballot here in California. But once again, I can’t do it without you.

If you can’t afford to make a contribution today, I understand, and I’m thankful for your support still — and that you made it this far in the email!
But if you can chip in today, I would really appreciate it. Here's a personalized link for you: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-april24/?supporter=dpwillis67@gmail.com**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-april24.UspfqC&refcode=em240416-1-t2&t=1&akid=1692%2E159979%2Eq0D3-s)
Thank you. It means so much to me to know you're on my side in the fight to defend the American dream.
Alex

Friends, If you look at any presidential battleground map over the last few decades, you can easily point to a small number of states that are always the ultimate deciders every four years. And within those states, national campaigns often focus specifically on high-density areas. **But our work here at the NDRC won’t be successful unless we are mobilizing voters in our priority states on a state-wide basis. Here’s why: ** Our 2024 electoral work is focused on state legislatures, state supreme courts, and ballot initiatives. In order to win these types of elections, where turnout is critical in urban, suburban, and rural regions alike, and candidates don’t start out with high name recognition, we need to organize and deploy resources to communicate with diverse voting blocs across different backgrounds and geographies. [**Basically, we need to focus our efforts in places that may not be getting much attention otherwise. That’s why we’re asking you to make a grassroots donation to the NDRC today to fuel our important work.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83161364/467490334/-803236760?refcode=don_ndrc_trddnrs_email_aprfun_email_20240416-NDRC-Red-PriorityState_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240416-NDRC-Red-PriorityState_&utm_campaign=aprfun&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjBiMGNhZTc2LTQ2ZmMtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=AfUySTlDNtyypw0pDp7zt9PpadVbj2hr7tWR2EBJX3k=) Even where our priority states overlap with presidential battlegrounds, a donation to the NDRC helps accomplish a distinct goal. Don’t get us wrong, every campaign’s work to turn out our base is _incredibly_ _important_ to our shared mission. But it’s our job to fill in the gaps where it's more difficult — and more expensive — to make inroads. **This is the most consequential election our democracy has ever seen.** We can’t afford to NOT have the resources to win these tough elections in our priority states that can be decided by a handful of votes. **Your donation to the NDRC today can help organize voter turnout efforts in critical areas that may not receive many resources otherwise. ## Jury Selection Begins in Trump Trial
Day one of former President Donald Trump's [so-called hush-money](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOgzAQBb8GOkd4d8GmcHFNulx7JTJ4HRwZGxknUf7-xNVXPj2NNJqf23SzIYZ0_7Ybm-rzxC9OId0nEnIQQBO0znhmYGzZSCURpUKCdjUoGRj8Mi8zAzrqWVnsWSo1LqQ1tsFAB9SRHOCEhoueR91J7makYSSChjp2oeZyeeSQ6so-fvKLy2XJWxvNWut-NPjVwLWBq90Tv4_zOkepYYncwLWW57aL9XmsYsuJP6KWYKN4PMtHHBx5qSEnoZ3Vqh-xB1J6Zs3eO3S9QrKWsee2GLe_Q4zhGFRD3X2zIf5p1P-r_AYAAP__ZyBjDQ) trial ended Monday with no jurors selected, but it featured numerous requests by both the defense and prosecutors. The [first 96 potential jurors](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GOwyAQBb8Gd1h4WeGkoLjGXa690sJmcTbCEAGJlb8_-errnvQ0Gs3Pbb45jpy2b7eTbSHP9KbEaZtRDkYCztB5G4iAdEd2GAeth1EjdHcLFwwUPLrRK7Vq0M4o45xHvyw-oO_YggJUOBg4IdNflutFDaQWjeaKCAIVeW659I_Mqd0pxE9-U-nXvHfR3lt7VqG_BEwCpuM4-nWpiY56_gKmcwqYWnntT9kKuygX2jhV2bJ3H_l4lY-sFGltnJOAqSvWPw-OkasZBaptdxz_ZO3_9t8AAAD__403XKo) from a pool of several hundred New York residents were sworn in just after 2 p.m. Judge Juan Merchan dismissed more than half after they indicated they could not be fair and impartial. Judge Merchan also [denied a request for Trump](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL-OtDAQw58mdFklk_BnixRfQ7dfeyUKMFnmFBJEBla8_Ymrr3Fhyz9Z_noNL0-R0vu_X9FxyAOemCi9Byt1I8EOUM0uIAKaCp1utTG6NRaqxekQ6rnGqZvaeWzrsauVNnoKtxHC2FTkQIFVVjdwl5pHNz47pVGNxjZPa0FYhTNx3h_fmRIvGOKVT9wfU16r6BbmrQjzT0AvoE_XlgvfkYD-Bgvo1S26FtAfRSb8FAE978e6FbkcZZFrTnjJdE2Sd_JRRjpRHtvsGYvc0U9MORW5LZlzkT75eBW6IdXu5u1DMVJpWmHVe_UUf2fx3y_9BAAA___rGGnS) to attend arguments on presidential immunity at the Supreme Court next week and delayed a decision for Trump to attend his son's high school graduation. The former president described the trial as political persecution in comments made after the court convened.
## Israeli Officials Meet to Plan Response
Israeli military officials met Monday and discussed [a potential response](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFvhSAURn8NbBq4XFAGhi5ve107GpCr0qC8KHmk_76xc9fvyznJ-XpOT59yOtZPv5OrS5noTUc61gk7aTrACXh0CxGQ4uTkIJWSg0Lgm6NZ-6CtN9pIa8ysPc4RtY4wBG9l5MmBABQoDdyQ6cdgRyFJBIXGIgJDQTHVcvbfJR11oyX_lDed_Vx2nt1W6-ti6oPBg8GjtdaHMN8fg8dB7brHcubY7SnGTB35q3ZmHEFYbfnp4qulnNNlBoZi3X3Kf-L6f-dvAAAA__-Cx1Ky) to Iran's unprecedented drone and missile attack. Iran launched hundreds of drones, ballistic missiles, and cruise missiles at Israel Saturday in response to a suspected Israeli strike in Syria two weeks ago. Israeli air defenses and warplanes, in coordination with the U.S.-led coalition of partners, [reportedly destroyed 99%](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAQRn-NvRHBQcEePHTJlq4drQOO5FoMEaBE_fdVOnf89OlJT-_zsl-QM5frBx60jVR3elDhct2NUFaA2WGOWyIC0jNtyimtldMG5tu26Lj4tCqNAZx7cx5jsgmlVS5qE5eZN5BgpFEWXpA9LX5dpCLptbGrMTAZSZFHbaevymXcKOWf-qB2CvWY83Yb494n_T7BeYIz3gs9--t6jTY4ZJrgfHAk7EMMKp1r6YJ7Q8qCGxYRWy0kcAwM3wIpaAvOS69WbyAGTGFZ0Rm5xACrndsW70_Ombt1k5HXAzn_qYz_y_wGAAD__wfIZHk) of the drones and missiles. At the conclusion of Monday's meeting, Israel's military chief Lieutenant[ General Herzi Halevi](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQxvGngQ2LOwi2B4Yu2dK1o4XLObkW4whoUN6-Sufu36e_fh-X5RI4cb6-h518246FHpQ5XxerwCm0C8roNyIkI8nDCMbAaCzKmwdtwZyCjriOOsQVjHFmnNZtmyBAnCV71Gi1BYevkxumdZ40kF6NdbO1KKymyO0ow9fBud1oS8_jQWX4PHaZ_K21exXmTeBZ4Ln3PmTqtRN9vwYCz1xLoKR2TtxCeSqu9YeqytRVD-XFUFxCVjDN-nQysvh475wSVzcKq6974PTXav_TfwMAAP__Mopakg) said the recent attack would be "met with a response." However, Halevi did not provide details, only saying Israel is still considering several plans. Despite describing the commitment to Israel as "ironclad," the Biden administration urged Israeli restraint and said the [U.S. wouldn't "participate ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwyAURp8Gb1jmcm0nA0MXb-na0eLnJr4tgQhoUN--Sudun_Tp6Ejn47JfLEdOt3d7J9OueacnJU63HaVaJOAOQzBXIiA9kFGr0lqtGmE4zBnXsM7gtZoVqDnMHsAjuNXRoryzAxuYACdUC7ygZTy582lSNDmNyxkRBE4UuOUyfmZO7aBr_MlPKqPP9yGao7VHFfpNwCZg672P3tVEvb5-AdtrCti4FktRcrFJFnoUrjbK2gp_kewHN5JH_q4kHQdKArahmPDoHCPXZRU43e6W45-y_V_gNwAA___N3V2h)in a reprisal strike on Iran."

Federal authorities have [opened an investigation](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uhDAQBOCnMZ2R_2SgcJGG7tKmRGuzcJsYG9nOoXv76KKU6T5pNNJoPm7LDShS2t_hQNe2vOADE6V9MVxarsyiutVtiAp1h04OUms5aKO6u4NpmyQAYAigtNAA0zSisMaCDkavHTkllBFGWvUq2X700ygkCq-NnYxRzAhcqeXSf2ZK7Y5bfOYHlj7ko4vu3tpZmX5jamZqvq6rTz4kvOorZ2p-kan5u_I_bZ54PjFVHgodlCDys2SPfCuQAlVeQ26Nf-GT-0LrjjzkGOGsyD3ERkcuyEtIIM0wSt0Vt54XxUjVDsyI_QCKv9va_1f9BAAA___1j2z0) into the cargo ship that crashed into Baltimore's Francis Scott Key Bridge, causing the bridge to collapse into the Patapsco River. America is under attack! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/c37c2071a261/trans-day-of-visibility-12690543?e=54a81bd33c)

---
| Dear Peter,
---
| | Our country is under attack. It’s plain for everyone to see, and the threat isn’t just coming from foreign enemies, but domestic enemies in the heart of our Nation's Capitol.

That’s why I’m thrilled to share that Veterans for Trump, also known as Veterans for America First (VFAF), has officially endorsed my candidacy for Congress. This endorsement is not just a badge of honor but a call to action for all of us who believe in the America First agenda to fight for our country.

Our Veterans swore an Oath to protect America from all of our enemies, both Foreign and Domestic. American Veterans have shed their blood for our country, [and I’m proud to have their support.](https://elizabethfornv.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ab8092551f57aee37054250c5&id=0bdd3f89c4&e=54a81bd33c)

Veterans For America First [released a statement saying](https://elizabethfornv.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ab8092551f57aee37054250c5&id=b9fcaf9833&e=54a81bd33c), "Elizabeth Helgelien is a true America First patriot that will fight for us in Congress, and she has our full support." My commitment to our veterans, first responders, and their communities is unwavering. Stan said:

_“Elizabeth Helgelien is a proven conservative who brings common sense to government. Her bulletproof conservative record on the issues earned her a rare 100% American Conservative Union rating. She earned an NRA A-rating in 2011 AND 2018.”_

The endorsement from Veterans For America First underscores my commitment to our foundational principles: economic freedom, secure borders, national security, the rule of law, and individual rights. As we face government corruption and societal challenges, I am more determined than ever to fight for our values in Congress.

But, to get there, [I need your support](https://elizabethfornv.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ab8092551f57aee37054250c5&id=7fd3b375ba&e=54a81bd33c).

Your [donation today](https://elizabethfornv.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ab8092551f57aee37054250c5&id=42f0939ec8&e=54a81bd33c) will fuel our campaign to address the issues Americans care about most. Together, we can ensure a future that cherishes our legacy and upholds the principles that make our country great. Let's stand united in this great hour of need and make history together.
---
| [Donate Now](https://elizabethfornv.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ab8092551f57aee37054250c5&id=0679aa0906&e=54a81bd33c "Donate Now")
---
| Join me in this fight. Your contribution, whether big or small, makes all the difference.

Thank you for your unwavering support.
---
| God Bless,
---
|
---
| **Elizabeth Helgelien**

body:
| [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-lbr.obk6Db&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240416_AM1_V1_S1&t=3&akid=2430%2E35263%2EHsN7hl) Attacks on reproductive health care have been in the news a lot lately, Peter. But there's one aspect that I feel gets lost in a lot of conversations around reproductive care: **Black maternal health.** What researchers have found is too egregious to ignore. In nearly every category, Black mothers are disproportionately impacted by insufficient access to maternal care. **Studies show that Black women are three times as likely to die from pregnancy-related complications as white women.** Maternal mortality rates continue to climb exponentially for Black women and women of color, and we cannot continue to turn a blind eye towards it. This is not a problem that will fix itself – it will take investment in communities of color. As a mother myself, and now, a first-time grandmother, I’ve seen personally the difficult health care experiences that Black women face all too often when pregnant. That’s why I've spent my career advocating for these issues as a proud member of the Black Maternal Health Caucus and the House Health Subcommittee. In the Senate, I'll work hard to improve maternal health for women across the board and ensure that under-resourced communities have a voice that advocates for maternal health. I'm ready to get to work, but we know this race won't be easy – that's why I need your support. **[Will you split any amount between my campaign and Tammy Baldwin? clean_body: | Attacks on reproductive health care have been in the news a lot lately, Peter. But there's one aspect that I feel gets lost in a lot of conversations around reproductive care: Black maternal health. What researchers have found is too egregious to ignore. In nearly every category, Black mothers are disproportionately impacted by insufficient access to maternal care. Studies show that Black women are three times as likely to die from pregnancy-related complications as white women. Maternal mortality rates continue to climb exponentially for Black women and women of color, and we cannot continue to turn a blind eye towards it. This is not a problem that will fix itself – it will take investment in communities of color. As a mother myself, and now, a first-time grandmother, I’ve seen personally the difficult health care experiences that Black women face all too often when pregnant. That’s why I've spent my career advocating for these issues as a proud member of the Black Maternal Health Caucus and the House Health Subcommittee. In the Senate, I'll work hard to improve maternal health for women across the board and ensure that under-resourced communities have a voice that advocates for maternal health. I'm ready to get to work, but we know this race won't be easy – that's why I need your support. body:
The public got an inside look at the dynamics of Missouri’s U.S. Senate race. Here’s what we learned:
#
Hey Peter, it’s Emma, deputy campaign manager on Lucas Kunce’s campaign for U.S. Senate here in Missouri.
**[If you’re already on board with our record-breaking grassroots movement, please add a donation by clicking this link.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45881?refcode=em20240416-5288&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5288%2E614464%2Eytji2D)** Otherwise, please keep reading.
I know Lucas emailed earlier about our historic Q1 fundraising numbers — and the fact that we once again outraised Josh Hawley’s campaign. But I wanted to take a few moments this evening to share a little more about why these numbers matter, and why we still need your help. **So will you please let me explain?**
The first quarter fundraising reports filed with the Federal Election Commission yesterday gave us an inside look into the dynamics of Missouri’s U.S. Senate race.
On Hawley’s side, we saw another massive transfer of money from DC-aligned groups and committees directly into Hawley’s campaign. Those transfers made up more than HALF of his reported total for the first three months of 2024.
**They’ve spent BIG to make Hawley look strong since this time last year.**
Meanwhile, our campaign raised more than 66,000 individual donations. We had a $33 average donation and NO transfers from national insiders or DC committees. Our grassroots campaign can’t count on that type of support.
With so many vulnerable incumbents up for re-election, Missouri hasn’t been a target for the groups you’d normally see getting involved in a race like ours.
**But with your support, we’ve managed to hold our own.**
We’ve consistently outraised Hawley’s campaign — without a cent from corporate PACs — and forced national insiders to spend millions propping him up.
We’ve reached hundreds of thousands of Missourians with Lucas’ message on TV, online, and at events across the state. Just last week, Lucas held a town hall in St. Charles that drew out more than 150 voters!
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45881?refcode=em20240416-5288&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5288%2E614464%2Eytji2D)
We’ve exposed Hawley’s attacks on reproductive rights across the spectrum — from birth control to IVF and the abortion pill. We even aired the first TV ad of any U.S. Senate campaign in the entire country about protecting IVF.
**And now, this race between Lucas and Hawley is already in a _statistical tie._**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45881?refcode=em20240416-5288&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5288%2E614464%2Eytji2D)
**We’ve made Missouri’s U.S. Senate race our best chance to flip a GOP-held Senate seat this November, but we still urgently need your help, Peter.**
The national insiders propping up Hawley’s campaign are spending more and more every quarter. And now, with even more evidence of the growing momentum behind our record-breaking grassroots campaign, they’ll spend whatever it takes to tear down Lucas and crush the movement we’re building together.
Unlike Hawley’s campaign, we can’t rely on anyone to swoop in and save the day. We’re proud to be completely powered by real people like you — without any money from corporate PACs or Big Oil + Big Pharma execs.
**But we absolutely can’t let up on our campaign’s historic momentum now.**
If we want to elect Lucas and win this race, there’s a lot of work ahead of us. From fighting back against the inevitable onslaught of attacks Hawley’s posse will throw at Lucas to reserving TV ad time and planning tours across the state — your support is what makes all that possible for our grassroots campaign.
**So I’m coming directly to you today:[Will you help keep up our campaign’s record-breaking grassroots momentum by adding your first donation of any amount today? With so much on the line this year, investing early in this U.S. Senate race could be your chance to make a real difference.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45881?refcode=em20240416-5288&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5288%2E614464%2Eytji2D)**

[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45901?refcode=em20240416-5288&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=5&akid=5288%2E614464%2Eytji2D) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45901?refcode=em20240416-5288&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=6&akid=5288%2E614464%2Eytji2D) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45901?refcode=em20240416-5288&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=7&akid=5288%2E614464%2Eytji2D) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45901?refcode=em20240416-5288&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=8&akid=5288%2E614464%2Eytji2D) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45901?refcode=em20240416-5288&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=9&akid=5288%2E614464%2Eytji2D) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45901?refcode=em20240416-5288&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=10&akid=5288%2E614464%2Eytji2D) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45881?refcode=em20240416-5288&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=5288%2E614464%2Eytji2D)

Emma Dillon
Team Lucas Kunce
